programme.desc: 平陵一战锦绣国败军之际，红衣女射手付一笑惊天一箭射中夙砂大皇子凤随歌，随即扭转战局。但付一笑却在平陵一战后不久，意外坠崖，记忆全失。凤随歌也被人追杀疲于奔命，阴差阳错下，二人在正念山庄重逢。看着失忆的付一笑，凤随歌只觉得此事处处透着蹊跷，于是决定将一笑带在身边，以引出操纵一切的幕后黑手。二人也由此踏上了揭露两国间阴谋的旅程。一路携手除敌党、斗权相，寻真相，从互相利用到互生爱意、成长励志。The female archer in red, Fu Yixiao, shockingly shoots an arrow at Susha's eldest prince, Feng Suige, turning the tide of the battle. programme.title: 猎罪图鉴 2 / Under the Skin II Episode 19
programme.desc: “猎罪图鉴”第二季将延续第一季的“绘色显影，画见人心”这一故事主轴，通过对画像的勾勒，洞悉人性的复杂。模拟画像师沈翊、刑警队长杜城等人组成的北江小分队，在第二季将继续拆解人性谜题，追击案件真凶。The second season of crime investigative drama series “Under the Skin” sees Shen Yi, portraitist with the talent to accurately sketch and restore back the images of killers, and Interpol police captain Du Cheng, unite and work together again to hunt down killers and resolve crime cases.

programme.title: 地狱里长 / What The Hell is Love Episode 4
programme.desc: 故事讲述每天黄昏5点20分就会见到鬼魂的热血里长罗一凡，在遇上笃信法律才能带来公平正义的菜鸟律师赵暖，与风度翩翩、温暖浪漫的菁英律师温为仁后，一连串的突发案件接二连三地开始发生，伴随着「信神」与「法律」的冲突辩证，各类离奇悬案等待破解的同时，隐藏在三人间巨大的秘密也渐渐浮现。

programme.title: 玉茗茶骨 / Glory Episode 11

programme.title: 成为饭吧 / A Good Supper Episode 77
programme.desc: 乡下小火车站周围有一家挂着“饭店”招牌的破旧白米饭店。女高中生英信虽然是高三学生，但为了饭店的生意，骑着自行车每天急急忙忙地往市场跑，这是为了给来饭店解决一顿饭的客人准备一顿既便宜又温暖的晚餐。英信从小就跟饭店老板京秀学做饮食。后来饭店还来了跟着离婚的父亲，一夜之间开始了农村生活的正勋...被妈妈爸爸抛弃，被老奶奶养大的五福...还有双职工夫妇所以晚上主要在饭店吃饭的多情...这些同龄人从小时开始长达12年的晚上都聚集在饭店里吃同一桌饭，铸就了比亲兄弟更亲密的情感，比家人更紧密的联系。

programme.title: 地狱里长 / What The Hell is Love Episode 5
programme.desc: 故事讲述每天黄昏5点20分就会见到鬼魂的热血里长罗一凡，在遇上笃信法律才能带来公平正义的菜鸟律师赵暖，与风度翩翩、温暖浪漫的菁英律师温为仁后，一连串的突发案件接二连三地开始发生，伴随着「信神」与「法律」的冲突辩证，各类离奇悬案等待破解的同时，隐藏在三人间巨大的秘密也渐渐浮现。

programme.title: 成为饭吧 / A Good Supper Episode 81
programme.desc: 乡下小火车站周围有一家挂着“饭店”招牌的破旧白米饭店。女高中生英信虽然是高三学生，但为了饭店的生意，骑着自行车每天急急忙忙地往市场跑，这是为了给来饭店解决一顿饭的客人准备一顿既便宜又温暖的晚餐。英信从小就跟饭店老板京秀学做饮食。后来饭店还来了跟着离婚的父亲，一夜之间开始了农村生活的正勋...被妈妈爸爸抛弃，被老奶奶养大的五福...还有双职工夫妇所以晚上主要在饭店吃饭的多情...这些同龄人从小时开始长达12年的晚上都聚集在饭店里吃同一桌饭，铸就了比亲兄弟更亲密的情感，比家人更紧密的联系。

programme.title: 一笑随歌 / Fated Hearts Episode 11
programme.desc: 平陵一战锦绣国败军之际，红衣女射手付一笑惊天一箭射中夙砂大皇子凤随歌，随即扭转战局。但付一笑却在平陵一战后不久，意外坠崖，记忆全失。凤随歌也被人追杀疲于奔命，阴差阳错下，二人在正念山庄重逢。看着失忆的付一笑，凤随歌只觉得此事处处透着蹊跷，于是决定将一笑带在身边，以引出操纵一切的幕后黑手。二人也由此踏上了揭露两国间阴谋的旅程。一路携手除敌党、斗权相，寻真相，从互相利用到互生爱意、成长励志。The female archer in red, Fu Yixiao, shockingly shoots an arrow at Susha's eldest prince, Feng Suige, turning the tide of the battle. programme.title: 型男大主厨 / Stylish Man Episode 877
programme.desc: 台湾广受欢迎的常青美食料理节目，由2006年始播至今，2011年还获选金钟奖的最佳综合节目主持人奖。每一期将有不同的主题：“大明星來下廚”由兩位明星或两个明星档分組對抗，拿出自己的拿手菜對抗比拼；“五分钟出好菜”由两位厨师根据指定食材，在五分钟内烹煮出易学美味的一道菜等。这是一个富有娱乐效果的轻松美食节目，能够持续制作这么多年不是没有理由的。

programme.title: 早餐中国第五季 / Breakfast In China S5 Episode 10
programme.desc: 《早餐中国》第5季，30种热气腾腾的早餐，30种人生况味。我们依然在拍摄那些微不足道的民间食物，依然在见证那些触手可及的人间奇迹。

programme.title: 川味 5 · 一宴千年 / Legendary Taste of Sichuan S5 Episode 3
programme.desc: 以四季节气与传统节日为线索，节目深入探寻四川巴蜀特色文化宴席，展现“宴”所承载的历史文化、民俗风情与非遗传承，呈现巴蜀独特而深厚的文化与美食魅力。Guided by the four seasons and traditional festivals, the series explores Sichuan bashu’s distinctive banquet culture, where every feast reflects history, folk traditions, and intangible heritage. Through seasonal cuisine, local flavours, customs, and landscapes, it celebrates the region's rich culinary legacy.

Rumors spread that he had been demoted, but the truth remains unknown. Three years later, when Sanin Group is facing bankruptcy with huge debts, he is called back to Korea as their last hope. His mission is clear - ...

programme.title: 早餐中国第五季 / Breakfast In China S5 Episode 10
programme.desc: 《早餐中国》第5季，30种热气腾腾的早餐，30种人生况味。我们依然在拍摄那些微不足道的民间食物，依然在见证那些触手可及的人间奇迹。

programme.title: 川味 5 · 一宴千年 / Legendary Taste of Sichuan S5 Episode 3
programme.desc: 以四季节气与传统节日为线索，节目深入探寻四川巴蜀特色文化宴席，展现“宴”所承载的历史文化、民俗风情与非遗传承，呈现巴蜀独特而深厚的文化与美食魅力。Guided by the four seasons and traditional festivals, the series explores Sichuan bashu’s distinctive banquet culture, where every feast reflects history, folk traditions, and intangible heritage. Through seasonal cuisine, local flavours, customs, and landscapes, it celebrates the region's rich culinary legacy.

programme.title: 亲切的善珠 / Desperate Mrs Seongju Episode 37
programme.desc: 社区室内设计师善珠倾尽全力支持丈夫，却遭背叛而离婚，毅然重启人生。建筑师金素宇因妻子移情别恋结束婚姻，仍保持平和与坚定。两位同样经历情感创伤的人，因工作相遇，在彼此陪伴中重拾希望，开启人生新篇章。When ambition and betrayal destroy two marriages, devoted interior designer Pi Seon Ju and steady architect Kim So U find their lives forever changed. As they rebuild from heartbreak, an unexpected bond offers hope, healing, and a chance to begin again.

programme.title: 飞到我心上 / Blossom Through the Cloud
programme.desc: After her pilot dream is crushed by Fu Mingyu's decision, flight attendant Ruan Sixian quits in humiliation. Three years later, she returns as a trained pilot forcing the man who once misjudged her to see her anew.

programme.title: 飞到我心上 / Blossom Through the Cloud Episode 2
programme.desc: Fu Mingyu is determined to recruit a brilliant female pilot only to discover she is Ruan Sixian. To win her back to Shihang, he even makes the sun appear to rise in the west, reopening a fate neither expected.

programme.title: 飞到我心上 / Blossom Through the Cloud Episode 3
programme.desc: Ruan Sixian's hostility baffles Fu Mingyu until a familiar moment unlocks the truth she is the flight attendant he humiliated three years ago. As guilt surfaces, his professional interest turns dangerously personal.

programme.title: 飞到我心上 / Blossom Through the Cloud Episode 4
programme.desc: A damaged supercar, a changed attitude, and a new Z101 campaign pull Ruan Sixian and Fu Mingyu closer. When he learns how much she sacrificed to become a pilot, admiration begins to blur into something deeper.

programme.title: 真料理两锅论第二季 / Let's Guo S2 Episode 4
programme.desc: 料理实境节目《真料理两锅论》由邰智源、罗时丰、黄镫辉、KID林柏升、温妮、丘涵共同主持。节目中主持人们将分为两组PK对决，亲自出马找寻稀有食材、超强主厨及传奇秘方与菜单，献上最美味的完美料理。Cooking reality show “Let’s Guo” is hosted by Taiwanese artistes Tai Chih-yuan, Lo Shih-feng, Huang Chien-hui, KID Lin Po-sheng, Winnie, and Chiu Han. In the show, the hosts are divided into two teams for competition, venturing out to seek for rare ingredients, exceptional chefs, and legendary recipes and menus, presenting the most delicious and perfect dishes.

programme.title: 不眠日 / Mobius
programme.desc: 一场银行爆炸案打破华澳市的宁静，警官丁奇站在惨烈的爆炸现场却异常平静。因为他知晓这并非“最终结局”而是“循环日”，世界会随机进入连续五次的循环，零点零分回溯前一天，普通人无感，唯有他靠时间循环感知力屡破奇案。新循环一次次开启，离奇之处相继显现：生物集团多名高管接连死亡，伴随着神秘的乌贼杀人警告，意外频发……看似机械重复的日常下，阴谋渐显。丁奇更发现，自己并非唯一掌控“时间密钥”的人。当多名时间循环感知者搅动时空，第五个循环日的最终对决，将为你揭开所有谜团。In a specific time and space, detective Ding Qi accidentally discovered that he had the ability to reverse time and repeat the cycle five times on the same day from time to time. programme.desc: 平陵一战锦绣国败军之际，红衣女射手付一笑惊天一箭射中夙砂大皇子凤随歌，随即扭转战局。但付一笑却在平陵一战后不久，意外坠崖，记忆全失。凤随歌也被人追杀疲于奔命，阴差阳错下，二人在正念山庄重逢。看着失忆的付一笑，凤随歌只觉得此事处处透着蹊跷，于是决定将一笑带在身边，以引出操纵一切的幕后黑手。二人也由此踏上了揭露两国间阴谋的旅程。一路携手除敌党、斗权相，寻真相，从互相利用到互生爱意、成长励志。The female archer in red, Fu Yixiao, shockingly shoots an arrow at Susha's eldest prince, Feng Suige, turning the tide of the battle. But Fu Yixiao accidentally falls off a cliff shortly after the battle and loses her memory. Feng Suige uses Fu Yixiao to find out the truth as to why he is being heavil...

programme.title: 真料理两锅论第二季 / Let's Guo S2 Episode 4
programme.desc: 料理实境节目《真料理两锅论》由邰智源、罗时丰、黄镫辉、KID林柏升、温妮、丘涵共同主持。节目中主持人们将分为两组PK对决，亲自出马找寻稀有食材、超强主厨及传奇秘方与菜单，献上最美味的完美料理。Cooking reality show “Let’s Guo” is hosted by Taiwanese artistes Tai Chih-yuan, Lo Shih-feng, Huang Chien-hui, KID Lin Po-sheng, Winnie, and Chiu Han. In the show, the hosts are divided into two teams for competition, venturing out to seek for rare ingredients, exceptional chefs, and legendary recipes and menus, presenting the most delicious and perfect dishes.

programme.title: 型男大主厨 / Stylish Man Episode 878
programme.desc: 台湾广受欢迎的常青美食料理节目，由2006年始播至今，2011年还获选金钟奖的最佳综合节目主持人奖。每一期将有不同的主题：“大明星來下廚”由兩位明星或两个明星档分組對抗，拿出自己的拿手菜對抗比拼；“五分钟出好菜”由两位厨师根据指定食材，在五分钟内烹煮出易学美味的一道菜等。这是一个富有娱乐效果的轻松美食节目，能够持续制作这么多年不是没有理由的。

programme.title: 亲切的善珠 / Desperate Mrs Seongju Episode 46
programme.desc: 社区室内设计师善珠倾尽全力支持丈夫，却遭背叛而离婚，毅然重启人生。建筑师金素宇因妻子移情别恋结束婚姻，仍保持平和与坚定。两位同样经历情感创伤的人，因工作相遇，在彼此陪伴中重拾希望，开启人生新篇章。When ambition and betrayal destroy two marriages, devoted interior designer Pi Seon Ju and steady architect Kim So U find their lives forever changed. As they rebuild from heartbreak, an unexpected bond offers hope, healing, and a chance to begin again.

programme.title: 残酷的实习生 / Cold Blooded Intern Episode 4
programme.desc: 高海拉7年前还是在业界叱咤风云的MD(常务理事)，凭借“工作狂”而闻名乘胜前进。但在过去的7年里，她是只埋头专注于育儿和家务事的主妇。在此期间她意识到自己的名字“高海拉”消失了，为了找回原来的角色和位置，她投身到了再就业战线。但在经历中断这一艰难的现实中，没有公司认可她之前的履历，为了重回职场她只好以实习生的身份孤军奋战。

programme.title: 一城一味·八闽有鲜味 / One City One Taste. Fujian Episode 6
programme.desc: 《一城一味·八闽有鲜味》，美食年番“一城一味”系列本季“八闽有鲜味”以福州为核心，以鲜味为指引，辐射周围的泉州、漳州、莆田、宁德、平潭等极具美食、人文、自然特色，且用户好奇度高的城市，寻觅最能代表当地特色的鲜味美食，突出食材鲜、做法鲜、味道鲜、佐料鲜的八闽鲜味。也通过一个个不同的美食与美食背后的故事，让观众感受到这些城市的温度与魅力。

programme.title: 申医生 / Doctor Shin
programme.desc: 剧集讲述外科医生，爱上因事故而陷入脑昏迷的知名女星，为拯救她而进行了禁忌的脑部置换手术，之后的故事交织着爱情与欲望、禁忌与牺牲。Genius neurosurgeon Shin Ju-shin is head over heels in love with top actress Momo. When Momo falls into a coma following a tragic accident, Ju-shin faces the prospect of losing her. Driven by desperation, he crosses ethical lines and performs a forbidden "brain change" or soul-transfer surgery. Momo eventually wakes up, but she is inhabited by a different consciousness, triggering tragic and unforeseen consequences.

programme.title: 不眠日 / Mobius
programme.desc: 一场银行爆炸案打破华澳市的宁静，警官丁奇站在惨烈的爆炸现场却异常平静。因为他知晓这并非“最终结局”而是“循环日”，世界会随机进入连续五次的循环，零点零分回溯前一天，普通人无感，唯有他靠时间循环感知力屡破奇案。新循环一次次开启，离奇之处相继显现：生物集团多名高管接连死亡，伴随着神秘的乌贼杀人警告，意外频发……看似机械重复的日常下，阴谋渐显。丁奇更发现，自己并非唯一掌控“时间密钥”的人。当多名时间循环感知者搅动时空，第五个循环日的最终对决，将为你揭开所有谜团。In a specific time and space, detective Ding Qi accidentally discovered that he had the ability to reverse time and repeat the cycle five times on the same day from time to time. He used this superpower to solve many difficult cases. One day, a murder notice suddenly...

programme.title: 江湖菜馆第五季 · 无肉不欢 / KungFu Licious S5 · Feast of Meat
programme.desc: 《江湖菜馆第五季 · 无肉不欢》以肉为主题设立六个单元，探访新疆、湖南、山东、北京、绍兴、成都、襄阳、长沙、重庆等18座城市，深入挖掘肉食江湖和市井烟火气。Food docu “KungFu Licious” returns with a fifth season to venture into the streets and alleys of 18 different cities, exploring meat-loving hotspots this time round and presenting the pleasures of meat through a huge variety of local meat delicacies.

programme.title: 川味 5 · 一宴千年 / Legendary Taste of Sichuan S5 Episode 4
programme.desc: 以四季节气与传统节日为线索，节目深入探寻四川巴蜀特色文化宴席，展现“宴”所承载的历史文化、民俗风情与非遗传承，呈现巴蜀独特而深厚的文化与美食魅力。Guided by the four seasons and traditional festivals, the series explores Sichuan bashu’s distinctive banquet culture, where every feast reflects history, folk traditions, and intangible heritage. Through seasonal cuisine, local flavours, customs, and landscapes, it celebrates the region's rich culinary legacy.

programme.desc: 《天赐的声音》第7季强势回归，节目邀请了十二至十五位歌手担任音乐合伙人，并由他们自行进行两两配对演唱；如果合伙人数量为单数，则最终会有一名歌手在该集节目轮空。在每轮歌曲演唱后，声音鉴赏团成员会在已演唱的歌曲中共同选出待定金曲，最终获得推荐金曲的搭档将分别担任下一期的队长，带领本队的三对歌手进行歌曲表演并角逐金曲称号。从第二阶段起，每期均会由在场观看录制的两百位观众额外选出一首人气金曲。“The Treasured Voice” is a captivating singing variety that sees each episode having different groups of music partners to sing together in pairs. programme.desc: 《江湖菜馆第五季 · 无肉不欢》以肉为主题设立六个单元，探访新疆、湖南、山东、北京、绍兴、成都、襄阳、长沙、重庆等18座城市，深入挖掘肉食江湖和市井烟火气。Food docu “KungFu Licious” returns with a fifth season to venture into the streets and alleys of 18 different cities, exploring meat-loving hotspots this time round and presenting the pleasures of meat through a huge variety of local meat delicacies.

programme.title: 地狱里长 / What The Hell is Love Episode 6
programme.desc: 故事讲述每天黄昏5点20分就会见到鬼魂的热血里长罗一凡，在遇上笃信法律才能带来公平正义的菜鸟律师赵暖，与风度翩翩、温暖浪漫的菁英律师温为仁后，一连串的突发案件接二连三地开始发生，伴随着「信神」与「法律」的冲突辩证，各类离奇悬案等待破解的同时，隐藏在三人间巨大的秘密也渐渐浮现。

programme.title: 玉茗茶骨 / Glory Episode 13
programme.desc: 年轻状元郎陆江来上任淳安县令后屡破奇案，却因卷入一桩杀妻旧案，从官场新星沦落至绝境。濒死之际，幸得茶王之女荣善宝搭救。两人联手整顿家族、开拓茶道，在茶园里缔结了一段爱情佳话的故事‌。After rising star magistrate Lu Jiang Lai is brought down by a past wife-murder case, he’s left injured and on the run, only to be rescued by Rong Shan Bao, the Tea King's daughter. programme.title: 成为饭吧 / A Good Supper Episode 85
programme.desc: 乡下小火车站周围有一家挂着“饭店”招牌的破旧白米饭店。女高中生英信虽然是高三学生，但为了饭店的生意，骑着自行车每天急急忙忙地往市场跑，这是为了给来饭店解决一顿饭的客人准备一顿既便宜又温暖的晚餐。英信从小就跟饭店老板京秀学做饮食。后来饭店还来了跟着离婚的父亲，一夜之间开始了农村生活的正勋...被妈妈爸爸抛弃，被老奶奶养大的五福...还有双职工夫妇所以晚上主要在饭店吃饭的多情...这些同龄人从小时开始长达12年的晚上都聚集在饭店里吃同一桌饭，铸就了比亲兄弟更亲密的情感，比家人更紧密的联系。

programme.desc: 乡下小火车站周围有一家挂着“饭店”招牌的破旧白米饭店。女高中生英信虽然是高三学生，但为了饭店的生意，骑着自行车每天急急忙忙地往市场跑，这是为了给来饭店解决一顿饭的客人准备一顿既便宜又温暖的晚餐。英信从小就跟饭店老板京秀学做饮食。后来饭店还来了跟着离婚的父亲，一夜之间开始了农村生活的正勋...被妈妈爸爸抛弃，被老奶奶养大的五福...还有双职工夫妇所以晚上主要在饭店吃饭的多情...这些同龄人从小时开始长达12年的晚上都聚集在饭店里吃同一桌饭，铸就了比亲兄弟更亲密的情感，比家人更紧密的联系。

programme.title: 地狱里长 / What The Hell is Love Episode 7
programme.desc: 故事讲述每天黄昏5点20分就会见到鬼魂的热血里长罗一凡，在遇上笃信法律才能带来公平正义的菜鸟律师赵暖，与风度翩翩、温暖浪漫的菁英律师温为仁后，一连串的突发案件接二连三地开始发生，伴随着「信神」与「法律」的冲突辩证，各类离奇悬案等待破解的同时，隐藏在三人间巨大的秘密也渐渐浮现。

programme.title: 很想很想你 / Love Me, Love My Voice Episode 2
programme.desc: 该剧根据墨宝非宝的同名小说《很想很想你》改编。主要讲述热爱音乐的大四学生顾声坚持梦想，默默坚守着另一个隐藏身份——古风圈小透明“声声慢”，并憧憬着能与自己的心动对象配音圈大神“锖青磁”合作一次的故事。

programme.title: 猎罪图鉴 2 / Under the Skin II Episode 21
programme.desc: “猎罪图鉴”第二季将延续第一季的“绘色显影，画见人心”这一故事主轴，通过对画像的勾勒，洞悉人性的复杂。模拟画像师沈翊、刑警队长杜城等人组成的北江小分队，在第二季将继续拆解人性谜题，追击案件真凶。The second season of crime investigative drama series “Under the Skin” sees Shen Yi, portraitist with the talent to accurately sketch and restore back the images of killers, and Interpol police captain Du Cheng, unite and work together again to hunt down killers and resolve crime cases.

programme.title: 一笑随歌 / Fated Hearts Episode 12
programme.desc: 平陵一战锦绣国败军之际，红衣女射手付一笑惊天一箭射中夙砂大皇子凤随歌，随即扭转战局。但付一笑却在平陵一战后不久，意外坠崖，记忆全失。凤随歌也被人追杀疲于奔命，阴差阳错下，二人在正念山庄重逢。看着失忆的付一笑，凤随歌只觉得此事处处透着蹊跷，于是决定将一笑带在身边，以引出操纵一切的幕后黑手。二人也由此踏上了揭露两国间阴谋的旅程。一路携手除敌党、斗权相，寻真相，从互相利用到互生爱意、成长励志。The female archer in red, Fu Yixiao, shockingly shoots an arrow at Susha's eldest prince, Feng Suige, turning the tide of the battle. programme.title: 奔跑吧特别篇 5 / Keep Running Special Season 5 Episode 9
programme.desc: 奔跑吧特别篇 5》着重于中国一些偏远和少为人知的地点城市，通过创新游戏设置，增加艺人与当地民众的互动，同时激发大众对奔跑的渴望、对温暖的传递和对美好的追求，以综艺化的特色表达传递正能量。节目还是由“奔跑吧”固定MC班底 - 超人气大卡艺人继续担纲主持任务。

programme.title: 亲切的善珠 / Desperate Mrs Seongju Episode 52
programme.desc: 社区室内设计师善珠倾尽全力支持丈夫，却遭背叛而离婚，毅然重启人生。建筑师金素宇因妻子移情别恋结束婚姻，仍保持平和与坚定。两位同样经历情感创伤的人，因工作相遇，在彼此陪伴中重拾希望，开启人生新篇章。When ambition and betrayal destroy two marriages, devoted interior designer Pi Seon Ju and steady architect Kim So U find their lives forever changed. As they rebuild from heartbreak, an unexpected bond offers hope, healing, and a chance to begin again.

programme.title: 地狱里长 / What The Hell is Love Episode 8
programme.desc: 故事讲述每天黄昏5点20分就会见到鬼魂的热血里长罗一凡，在遇上笃信法律才能带来公平正义的菜鸟律师赵暖，与风度翩翩、温暖浪漫的菁英律师温为仁后，一连串的突发案件接二连三地开始发生，伴随着「信神」与「法律」的冲突辩证，各类离奇悬案等待破解的同时，隐藏在三人间巨大的秘密也渐渐浮现。

programme.title: 很想很想你 / Love Me, Love My Voice Episode 3
programme.desc: 该剧根据墨宝非宝的同名小说《很想很想你》改编。主要讲述热爱音乐的大四学生顾声坚持梦想，默默坚守着另一个隐藏身份——古风圈小透明“声声慢”，并憧憬着能与自己的心动对象配音圈大神“锖青磁”合作一次的故事。

programme.title: 猎罪图鉴 2 / Under the Skin II Episode 22
programme.desc: “猎罪图鉴”第二季将延续第一季的“绘色显影，画见人心”这一故事主轴，通过对画像的勾勒，洞悉人性的复杂。模拟画像师沈翊、刑警队长杜城等人组成的北江小分队，在第二季将继续拆解人性谜题，追击案件真凶。The second season of crime investigative drama series “Under the Skin” sees Shen Yi, portraitist with the talent to accurately sketch and restore back the images of killers, and Interpol police captain Du Cheng, unite and work together again to hunt down killers and resolve crime cases.

programme.title: 一笑随歌 / Fated Hearts Episode 13
programme.desc: 平陵一战锦绣国败军之际，红衣女射手付一笑惊天一箭射中夙砂大皇子凤随歌，随即扭转战局。但付一笑却在平陵一战后不久，意外坠崖，记忆全失。凤随歌也被人追杀疲于奔命，阴差阳错下，二人在正念山庄重逢。看着失忆的付一笑，凤随歌只觉得此事处处透着蹊跷，于是决定将一笑带在身边，以引出操纵一切的幕后黑手。二人也由此踏上了揭露两国间阴谋的旅程。一路携手除敌党、斗权相，寻真相，从互相利用到互生爱意、成长励志。The female archer in red, Fu Yixiao, shockingly shoots an arrow at Susha's eldest prince, Feng Suige, turning the tide of the battle. programme.title: 这就是街舞 6 / Street Dance of China 6 Episode 13
programme.desc: 《这！就是街舞》再次强势回归，第六季节目迎来了常驻舞蹈导师的全新组合，包括Jay Park、Vanness 吴建豪、丁程鑫，都是非常优秀的舞者以及队长。在全新一季《这！就是街舞》中，将会有哪些街舞大神为大家带来热血炸裂的舞台？内容上不断带来惊喜外，让我们共同期待街舞引燃2023！

programme.title: Artist To Icon Episode 10
programme.desc: Features interviews with Tom Cruise's stunt coordinator Wade Eastwood, Taps co-star Billy Van Zandt, Interview With The Vampire producer Stephen Woolley, plus many more.

programme.title: Kylie Minogue: Pop Icon
programme.desc: This documentary chronicles the extraordinary life and career of Kylie Minogue, from her early days on the Australian soap opera "Neighbours" to her rise as a global music sensation.

programme.title: Air Warriors S11 Episode 10
programme.desc: This documentary series shows five generations of jet engines. These fighter jets are capable of carrying bombs and soar close to the edge of space. The sixth generation of fighter jets began in 2020, and the 11th season has covered most of the air artillery since then.

programme.title: Air Warriors S11
programme.desc: This documentary series shows five generations of jet engines. These fighter jets are capable of carrying bombs and soar close to the edge of space. The sixth generation of fighter jets began in 2020, and the 11th season has covered most of the air artillery since then.

programme.title: Muhammad Ali: The Greatest
programme.desc: Muhammad Ali, the greatest fighter ever, remains a global icon. His name still commands respect. Hear from those who knew him, relive his legendary fights, and explore the life of boxing's greatest symbol.

programme.title: Kate Winslet: Leading Lady
programme.desc: Oscar-winner Kate Winslet, known for Titanic, is celebrated for her versatile, intense performances in both Hollywood blockbusters and indie films, cementing her as one of the finest actors of her generation.

programme.title: Sting: Ever Evolving
programme.desc: Sting: Ever Evolving is an enthralling documentary that delves into the multifaceted life of one of music's most iconic figures. The documentary offers an unprecedented glimpse into the mind of a musical legend, showcasing how his art continues to inspire and challenge the world.

programme.title: P!nk: Fearless
programme.desc: Pink is a powerhouse of pop and rock music. Although initially seen as yet another act in the late 90's crowd of teen pop acts, she has since gone on to define her own genre and solidified her place as a standout from the rest. She is a force to be reckoned with in the music scene.

programme.title: Carrie Underwood: Southern Grace
programme.desc: From a small-town farm in Checotah, Oklahoma, to the biggest stages in the world — Carrie Underwood's journey is the story of a dream, a voice, and a fire that couldn't be ignored. This is the story of Carrie Underwood — the all-American girl who became a living legend.

programme.title: Helen Mirren: Queen Of Stage And Screen
programme.desc: This documentary explores Helen Mirren's fearless career, tracing her journey from a humble upbringing to becoming a global icon. It covers her early successes in the world of theatre as well as her wide range of film and television roles.

programme.title: P!nk: Fearless
programme.desc: Pink is a powerhouse of pop and rock music. Although initially seen as yet another act in the late 90's crowd of teen pop acts, she has since gone on to define her own genre and solidified her place as a standout from the rest. She is a force to be reckoned with in the music scene.

programme.title: Nature Sanctuaries Episode 4
programme.desc: Step back in time! Explore Queensland's ancient wetlands and primary rainforests. Home to survivors of prehistoric eras, it's a vibrant journey to the very origins of tropical Australia.

programme.title: Nature Sanctuaries Episode 5
programme.desc: Small country, massive impact! Costa Rica hosts 5% of all Earth's species. Trek from peaks to shores to see why protecting this rich, living sanctuary is an absolute necessity for our planet.

programme.title: Destination Myanmar
programme.desc: Destination Myanmar will take the audience to some of Myanmar's most beautiful and stunning Asian Heritage wetlands with fishermen paddling one-legged along shallow waters and floating gardens.

programme.title: Destination Flavour: China Episode 7
programme.desc: Adam Liaw arrives to the fiery provinces of Sichuan and Hunan and this time he's joined by celebrated chef and author Fuchsia Dunlop who is an expert on the region.

programme.title: Destination Flavour: China Episode 8
programme.desc: Adam Liaw is in Fujian - a place with a long history of migration where the movement of people left an enduring mark that manifested in its food and culture.

programme.title: Destination Flavour: China Episode 9
programme.desc: Adam Liaw heads to the home of Cantonese cuisine - Hong Kong and Guangdong to discover the regional cuisine that spread to all corners of the world.

programme.title: Destination Flavour: China Episode 10
programme.desc: Adam Liaw's last stop is the very special Hainan Island - a balmy, tropical island and Adam's ancestral home.

programme.title: Evolving Vegan
programme.desc: Mena restaurant-hops with friends Lilly Singh and Laura Marano, indulging in plant-based French pastries, "pastrami" sammies, Thai "chicken" wings and "carne" asada.

programme.title: The Story Of Playstation
programme.desc: With video-games on the rise, Sony, the tech superpower would attempt a collaboration with Nintendo. After a shocking betrayal, Sony founded what would become the world's most successful chain of video game consoles. The Playstation was here to stay.

programme.title: Mega Transports Specials
programme.desc: A unique mega transport made of steel and titanium with a special purpose: to extract tons of gold. This so-called autoclave is the biggest of its kind.

programme.title: Mega Transports Specials Episode 2
programme.desc: This giant magnet will revolutionize the world and energy production in the future. The world's largest nuclear fusion reactor is currently under construction in southern France.

programme.title: Fantastic Friends S2 Episode 4
programme.desc: In Istanbul, James and Oliver meet Natalie Tena at Galata Tower. They cross the Bosphorus, ride the Eastern Express train through snowy mountains for ski-dooing, and sample Turkish cuisine, baklava, and exotic spices at the market.

programme.title: Fantastic Friends S2 Episode 5
programme.desc: The Phelps twins meet Alfie Allen in Tampa's Ybor City. They eat at the oldest Cuban restaurant, play ice hockey with the Tampa Bay Lightning, play baseball, enjoy local seafood and brews, and visit the city's most haunted hotels.

programme.title: Fantastic Friends S2 Episode 6
programme.desc: Joined by Genesis Rodriguez in Santiago, Chile, James and Oliver visit a Lapis Lazuli workshop, experience a circus, and learn the Cueca dance. They also tour stunning vineyards, sample fine wines, and cook traditional empanadas.

programme.title: Fantastic Friends S2 Episode 7
programme.desc: James and Oliver set off on a road trip to Lake Como with Stan Ianevski. Passing through French vineyards and the Swiss Alps, they learn watchmaking, navigate the dangerous Furka Pass, and end with a relaxing boat ride on Lake Como.

programme.title: Fantastic Friends S2 Episode 8
programme.desc: In Patagonia, the twins join Matthew Lewis in Punta Arenas. They hike to Base Las Torres, reminisce about Harry Potter, learn sheep herding and horseback riding with Baqueanos, and spot a wild puma using a night-vision camera.

programme.title: Fantastic Friends S2
programme.desc: James and Oliver Phelps join Alfie Enoch in Belize. They explore Mayan ruins at Lamanai, visit water caves, learn about Mennonite culture, tour San Pedro's street food, fly over the Blue Hole, and dive in the Hol Chan coral reefs.

programme.title: Kylie Minogue: Pop Icon
programme.desc: This documentary chronicles the extraordinary life and career of Kylie Minogue, from her early days on the Australian soap opera "Neighbours" to her rise as a global music sensation.

programme.title: Cher: Sharing Her Story
programme.desc: Step into the world of Cher, an enduring icon whose journey from humble beginnings to superstardom has shaped pop culture for over five decades. A true pioneer, she's dominated music charts, reinvented herself in film, and built a legacy that transcends entertainment. programme.title: Great Blue Wild Season 3 Episode 2
programme.desc: The wild coastline of Mozambique stretches along more than 1,600 miles - an area teeming with a diversity of marine life. Some of the world's largest filter feeders are attracted to this nutrient-rich water. But even these large creatures are defenceless against reckless overfishing. Two of Mozambique's leading marine researchers, Andrea Marshall and Nakia Cullain, set out to find one of the ocean's most secretive animals and protect its most well known, before its too late.

programme.title: Supersenses Season 1
programme.desc: Vision – it's how ninety-five percent of animals interpret the world. Every species on Earth is a chapter in the fascinating story of sight. This episode follows that story from blurry beginnigs to mind-blowing hexnocular vision.

programme.title: Macro Worlds Season 1 Episode 3
programme.desc: Beetles have inhabited the Earth for more than 240 million years. There are around 380,000 kinds of beetles known to scientists and every year hundreds of new species are discovered. One fourth of the world's animals are beetles. They have conquered almost every corner and every habitat on the planet and they have survived every global disaster. What is it that makes them so successful?

programme.title: Arabian Seas Season 1
programme.desc: The seas are alive with carnivores. Meet the sharks and rays who patrol the coral reefs, hunting down their prey. Learn about toxic fish who disguise themselves to ambush the unwary, and armoured predators who devour vulnerable targets.

programme.title: Secrets of the Enchanted Forests Season 1
programme.desc: Circle the equator for a look at the diverse species that dwell in tropical forests. Meet a lone sloth growing a mini-forest, lemurs that share and share alike, and elephants that tend to their woodland gardens. Then explore the region's dark side.

programme.title: Undiscovered Vistas Season 3
programme.desc: Dive under Mexico's Yucatán rainforest into an elaborate network of flooded caves called cenotes. Learn how underground rivers feed the waterless surface on their way to the sea, supporting legions of bats, howler monkeys, and more curious species.

programme.title: Undiscovered Vistas Season 3 Episode 2
programme.desc: Find surprises in Mexico's untamed Sierra Gorda biosphere. Prowl the arid semi-desert with horned lizards, marvel at axolotl regeneration in the river-fed foothills, and soar with monarch butterflies in the treetops high above a hazy cloud forest.

programme.title: Mysteries of Evolution Season 1 Episode 5
programme.desc: Cooperation comes in many forms. Some animals cooperate to be social while others put the welfare of the group above their own reproductive potential. See the many ways species have evolved to work with one another in order to survive.

programme.title: Ocean Parks Season 1 Episode 5
programme.desc: The Exuma Cays are a remote wonder: hundreds of tiny islands extending south from the Bahamian Capital of Nassau. In the 1950's, developers dreamed of developing this pristine, and largely unexplored region. But before construction could begin, the Bahamian government supported an expedition to chart the cays. They liked what they saw, and in 1959 established the Bahamas National Trust, creating the Bahamas' first Ocean Park.

programme.title: Land of Gremlins Season 1 Episode 3
programme.desc: Explore the lives of Madagascar's cold-blooded creatures. Chameleons, frog, lizards, and snakes have all adapted in order to survive on the island. We take a look at how they find food, reproduce, and avoid predators.

programme.title: New Kids in the Wild Season 2
programme.desc: Test limits with jaguar cub Frida, who's honing her survival skills in Brazil's Caiman Lodge Reserve. Learn how to sneak with mum Gatuna, see sister Anouk help her hide from hungry interlopers, and go on a reckless solo trek that takes a lucky turn.

programme.title: New Kids in the Wild Season 2 Episode 2
programme.desc: Watch sea lion Lola take her first chaotic steps into a macho battlefield on Argentina's coast. Cheer as this baby learns key vocal and swimming skills, fights to stay by mom Maria's side, and makes a lightning-fast escape from the jaws of death.

programme.title: New Kids in the Wild Season 2 Episode 3
programme.desc: Feel the enchantment of Brazil's Atlantic Forest as southern muriqui Dora takes her first steps away from mum Mimi. Get lessons in spider monkey troop dynamics, bone up on tail-hanging technique, and see this baby find her place among her peers.

programme.title: New Kids in the Wild Season 2 Episode 4
programme.desc: Set a course for adventure with Thiago, a brave baby coati. Find out how this raccoon-like fellow sharpens his sniffing and foraging skills, crosses suburban roads near his lush Brazilian forest home, and avoids inanimate and four-legged dangers.

programme.title: New Kids in the Wild Season 2 Episode 5
programme.desc: Visit the last stronghold of the giant river otter in Brazil's beautiful Pantanal wetland. Track pup Rio and his siblings as they test the waters, team up to evade a jaguar ambush, and become a cohesive family unit that hunts and thrives together.

programme.title: Gangs of Lemur Island Season 1 Episode 5
programme.desc: The pressure to find food reaches new heights and throws the reserve into turmoil. Witness fractures emerge within the ranks, dividing the gangs and leading Crystal, the indomitable leader of the Ruins gang, to face a challenge like none before.

programme.title: Great Blue Wild Season 3
programme.desc: The Wild Coast of South Africa stretches for 170 miles. Here, the waters of the Indian and the Atlantic converge, forcing powerful waves towards the shoreline. This is where the Mozambique-based manta ray researcher Andrea Marshall hopes to conduct her first-ever manta ray expedition within South Africa's borders...

programme.title: Great Blue Wild Season 3 Episode 2
programme.desc: The wild coastline of Mozambique stretches along more than 1,600 miles - an area teeming with a diversity of marine life. Some of the world's largest filter feeders are attracted to this nutrient-rich water. But even these large creatures are defenceless against reckless overfishing. Two of Mozambique's leading marine researchers, Andrea Marshall and Nakia Cullain, set out to find one of the ocean's most secretive animals and protect its most well known, before its too late.

programme.title: Great Blue Wild Season 3 Episode 3
programme.desc: The coast of Mozambique is home to giants, like humpbacks and whale sharks, but the tiniest species play just as big of a role in the ecosystem. Meet the scientists who are working against the clock to protect coastal creatures big and small.

programme.title: Great Blue Wild Season 3 Episode 4
programme.desc: The ocean sprawls across 70 percent of our planet and is home to as many as one million known species of plants and animals. However, it is the smallest of ocean creatures that underpins the world's largest food web – plankton. These microscopic organisms drift through the ocean's diverse habitats, triggering feeding cycles in their wake. Without them, life in the ocean would cease to exist.

programme.title: Wild Sky Season 1
programme.desc: Scan the Australian skies, which regularly deliver some of the world's most volatile weather. Await cooling monsoon rains, watch lightning ignite vast wildfires, and marvel at the ingenious adaptations that help wildlife deal with these extremes.

programme.title: Wild Sky Season 1 Episode 2
programme.desc: Experience the powerful, colourful phenomena that swirl across the heavens in North America. Watch polar bears search for food under the aurora borealis, map the frigid path of a polar vortex, and elude violent tornadoes with a prairie dog family.

programme.title: Wild Sky Season 1 Episode 3
programme.desc: Observe the eternal search for water that defines the lives of Africa's wild animals. Witness the biggest marine feeding frenzy on Earth, see how cobras stock up on solar power, and join wildebeest herds and elephant clans on their epic migrations.

programme.title: Wild Side of the Moon Season 1
programme.desc: Explore how lunar phases set the rhythm for an endless contest between predator and prey. Soar by moonlight with colugos, gorge on a shellfish feast with macaques, and watch a prowling pride of lions try to turn a baby elephant into dinner.

programme.title: Alien Abyss Season 1
programme.desc: Get acquainted with an array of ocean oddballs and learn how billions of years' worth of changes, from ice ages to asteroid strikes, have shaped their looks and skills. Meet blind worms who fish, walking sharks, tree-climbing crabs, and much more.

programme.title: Alien Abyss Season 1 Episode 2
programme.desc: Feel the love in the strange-but-heartwarming partnerships between some of Earth's oddest creatures. Dive deep to see strange animals, from snapping shrimp to wolf eels, offer a hand to their fellow ocean-going weirdos to ensure mutual survival.

programme.title: Alien Abyss Season 1 Episode 3
programme.desc: Channel your inner sci-fi fan and explore the bizarre mating rituals of the ocean's most peculiar creatures. Learn how bloody battles for mates, gender bending and supersize litters of babies just might secure a next generation for these animals.

programme.title: Animal Senses Season 1 Episode 2
programme.desc: The sense of touch is useful to feel physical forces such as bites, changes in temperature and texture. Some animals have become extra sensitive to very faint vibrations, which gives them a lot of information about their environment.

programme.title: Africa's Hidden Kingdoms Season 1
programme.desc: This documentary looks at the wildlife of The Drakensberg Mountain range. We take a look at how creatures survive in the hostile landscape, from the highest peaks to the rolling grasslands below.

programme.title: Island of the Monsoon Season 1
programme.desc: The shadowy forests of Yala National Park are the perfect hideout for secretive leopards. It's time for one young female, Asha, to strike out alone. Join her as she fights for her own territory, finds a mate, and becomes a mother.

programme.title: Island of the Monsoon Season 1 Episode 2
programme.desc: Every year, the biggest elephant congregation in Asia occurs in Minneriya National Park. Here in this sacred place, baby Loka is born. Watch as he learns to suckle, swim and handle his trunk among the mêlée of giants that make up his family.

programme.title: Island of the Monsoon Season 1 Episode 3
programme.desc: Sri Lanka's lowlands are dotted with thousands of seemingly peaceful lakes, but don't be fooled, this is the realm of the mugger crocodile. Muggers are hunters from day one. Watch as these supreme predators compete with each other in the fierce heat.

programme.title: Island of the Monsoon Season 1 Episode 4
programme.desc: A manmade lake in Minneriya National Park supports the largest concentration of elephants in Asia. Follow a young male who has reached a turning point toward adulthood. In the rainforest, jungles teem with a variety of bizarre species of insects.

programme.title: Island of the Monsoon Season 1 Episode 5
programme.desc: Monsoon storms sweep over the tropical island of Sri Lanka, and water carried in with swirling mists hits the mountainous heartland, beginning a journey through the many changing faces of the island's forests.

programme.title: Island of the Monsoon Season 1 Episode 6
programme.desc: Yala National Park is an avian Eden, home to 215 species of bird. This paradise offers many possibilities for parents who can weather the ever-changing climate. Every species must either raise their offspring here or find a new home before the dry season ends and the monsoon storms begin.

programme.title: Cub Camp Season 1 Episode 5
programme.desc: Spy on the summer cubs as they learn to climb trees and forage for food in preparation for their release into the wild. Get surprised by a set of new arrivals, observe the annual pre-hibernation eating binge, and enjoy a bear-friendly Thanksgiving.

programme.title: Cub Camp Season 1 Episode 6
programme.desc: Prepare for the summer cubs' release with Roger, then meet Ace and Little Blueberry, two newbies with serious health issues who will have to stay over the winter with the Z cubs. Later, celebrate as six healthy, happy bears embark on their new life.

programme.title: Supersenses Season 1
programme.desc: Vision – it's how ninety-five percent of animals interpret the world. Every species on Earth is a chapter in the fascinating story of sight. This episode follows that story from blurry beginnigs to mind-blowing hexnocular vision.

programme.title: Supersenses Season 1 Episode 2
programme.desc: See the animals that push the limits of physics, chemistry and engineering to pull off feats that humans can only dream of, and find out how evolution granted them with such amazing abilities. Sometimes it takes a super-power just to survive.

programme.title: Supersenses Season 1 Episode 3
programme.desc: Dive into a dazzling world beyond human perception, where animals use their super senses to detect light we can't see, sound we can't hear and even stranger forces we can't begin to detect.

programme.title: Ireland's Wild Islands Season 1
programme.desc: Endure winter and early spring on the west coast, where animals eke out a chilly existence. Watch red deer battle on windswept Inishvickillane, welcome seal pups amid howling storms on the Inishkea islands, and view the return of the basking sharks.

programme.title: Ireland's Wild Islands Season 1 Episode 2
programme.desc: Explore a 1,500-year-old monastery among the dizzying crags of the world-famous Skellig Islands. Spy Manx shearwaters and humpback whales, then chase after pygmy shrews on Clare before heading to the Aran Islands for a peek at an autumn spectacle.

programme.title: Europe's Wild Kingdom Season 1
programme.desc: Discover how Europe's best architecture has created sanctuaries for some of the continent's rarest species. Journey to France, Scotland, and Spain, where seals, birds, newts, wildcats, and snakes thrive among ancient landmarks at the water's edge.

programme.title: Europe's Wild Kingdom Season 1 Episode 2
programme.desc: Witness animal drama among Europe's most dramatic peaks. Visit medieval castles in Romania and France where bears, lynx, and falcons are making a comeback, then check out a rock lizard that's cleverly adapting to climate change in the Pyrenees.

programme.title: Secrets of the Enchanted Forests Season 1 Episode 4
programme.desc: Climb into a realm of thin air and towering rock. Tag along as mythical monkeys battle for a winter food stash, sing along with lemurs in a fruit-filled tree canopy, and watch an aromatic tree bring together blossom and possum in a moonlit tryst.

programme.title: Secrets of the Enchanted Forests Season 1 Episode 5
programme.desc: Travel to the Arctic for a peek at the brutal challenges of life in the boreal forest, then admire some stellar animal adaptations. Witness a secret reindeer superpower, navigate a rodent labyrinth of snow, and learn why moose are gourmets at heart.

programme.title: Secrets of the Enchanted Forests Season 1 Episode 6
programme.desc: Learn how plants and animals tough it out in some of the driest terrain Earth has to offer. Run across thirsty trees that act as elephant signposts, see insects team up with plants for a chance at life, and get insight into natural chemical warfare.

programme.title: Animal Senses Season 1 Episode 3
programme.desc: Seeing the world is one of the most amazing animal adaptations. Different types of eyes give animals different types of vision, and in some cases they can be extraordinary.

programme.title: Stormborn Season 1 Episode 3
programme.desc: In Iceland only one out of six cubs has survived. Abandoned by her parents, she now has to fend for herself. The reindeer herd swim two miles across open water. In Scotland, 35,000 grey seals arrive for their annual breeding season.

programme.title: Weird, Wild & Wonderful
programme.desc: Trek across Africa for a peek at the colorful, quirky survival strategies of its animals. See these furry, feathered, and scaled magicians, from flamboyant flamingos to vanishing lizards, find food, elude predators, and find mates against all odds.

programme.title: Wild Sky Season 1 Episode 3
programme.desc: Observe the eternal search for water that defines the lives of Africa's wild animals. Witness the biggest marine feeding frenzy on Earth, see how cobras stock up on solar power, and join wildebeest herds and elephant clans on their epic migrations.

programme.title: Africa's Hunters Season 3
programme.desc: While the dominant males roam nearby territories, hunting duties fall to the Mwamba pride's nine strong lionesses. See how they cope with the approach of the rainy season and six growing teenagers with boundless appetites.

programme.title: Africa's Hunters Season 3 Episode 2
programme.desc: As the lionesses set out to recover the males who are needed to hunt buffalo, they must cross a crocodile-infested river. Follow Milo, the only cub in the mighty Mwamba pride, as he's saved from snapping jaws and cements the family's future.

programme.title: Wildlife ER Season 3
programme.desc: Dive into a busy summer at the RSPCA Wildlife Hospital, where vet Emily takes the pressure off a gassy koala mum. Shadow the team as they fight a wave of lorikeet paralysis syndrome and see vet Karina use a teddy bear to rescue a flying fox pup.

programme.title: Mysteries of the Mekong Season 1
programme.desc: The source of the Mekong River is high up in the Tibetan plateau, from there it flows into Yunnan Province, China, where our journey begins. Even though Yunnan occupies less than 4% of China's land, it is home to over half of its birds and mammals.

programme.desc: Off the coast of Oman, summer weather drives nutrients in from the ocean depths where they meet the Arabian sun, causing an explosion of life. Smaller fish spawn, filling the waters with eggs. This creates a buffet predators just can't resist.

programme.desc: Join vets Emily and Martine in the OR, where Dolly the koala's spaying surgery takes a scary turn. Aid a run-over echidna with vet Nigel, see rescue officer Chantelle's slick fix for a snared lizard, and probe a possible birdnapping with vet Karina.

programme.desc: Leon rose to the rank of Viscount thanks to his achievements. He hopes to finally live a peaceful life, but the Temple seizes his spoils of war, and he is selected to join the Saint's Guard.

programme.title: Trapped in a Dating Sim 2: The World of Otome Games is Tough for Mobs Episode 2
programme.desc: The party heads to an island of elves in search of treasure! Leon suspects Marie was also reincarnated and questions her true intentions, but then the ground beneath them collapses.

programme.title: Trapped in a Dating Sim 2: The World of Otome Games is Tough for Mobs Episode 3
programme.desc: The Chieftess divines the future for Leon and the others. Meanwhile, Leon proposes an idea after learning about Yumeria and her son Kyle's experience with discrimination.

programme.title: Trapped in a Dating Sim 2: The World of Otome Games is Tough for Mobs Episode 4
programme.desc: Leon is arrested on suspicion of treason against the Kingdom. He agrees to be imprisoned in the dungeon to uncover the true enemy. Meanwhile, Angelica casts a suspicious glance at Hertrude.

programme.title: Trapped in a Dating Sim 2: The World of Otome Games is Tough for Mobs Episode 5
programme.desc: The Principality launches an invasion, and martial law is imposed on the royal capital. While Julius and the others attempt to rescue Leon, the Marquis' faction sends an assassin after him.

programme.title: Trapped in a Dating Sim 2: The World of Otome Games is Tough for Mobs Episode 6
programme.desc: As the Kingdom's army is overwhelmed by the guardians of the sky and sea, Leon declares himself Supreme Commander. He asks Mylene for her help in using the lost item, "The Royal Ship," but…

programme.title: Trapped in a Dating Sim 2: The World of Otome Games is Tough for Mobs Episode 7
programme.desc: Marie is Leon's younger sister from his previous life. Although Leon is shocked by her life before reincarnating, he intends to hold her accountable for the chaos she has caused here.

programme.title: Trapped in a Dating Sim 2: The World of Otome Games is Tough for Mobs Episode 8
programme.desc: Leon urges the citizens to evacuate while attempting to activate the Royal Ship. The key is the power of love! Marie and the others take on a device that quantifies love compatibility.

programme.title: Trapped in a Dating Sim 2: The World of Otome Games is Tough for Mobs Episode 9
programme.desc: Leon entrusts Luxion with holding off the Guardian of the Sea as the Guardian of the Sky approaches the Capital. The royal ship soon sets sail, and the Kingdom's counterattack begins, but...

programme.title: Trapped in a Dating Sim 2: The World of Otome Games is Tough for Mobs Episode 10
programme.desc: The Royal Ship emits a light that drains everyone's fighting spirit except for Vandel, who is immune to its effects and attacks the ship's systems. When all hope seems lost, Leon appears!

programme.title: Trapped in a Dating Sim 2: The World of Otome Games is Tough for Mobs Episode 11
programme.desc: Leon clashes with Vandel, who has fused with the magic armour. Meanwhile, Olivia and the others head toward the Principality's ship to find Hertrude, who possesses the magic flute.

programme.title: Trapped in a Dating Sim 2: The World of Otome Games is Tough for Mobs Episode 12
programme.desc: Reincarnated into a female-dominated otome game, Leon survives using his game knowledge. But as the story changes and Marie hijacks the heroine's role, he gets embroiled in a conspiracy…

programme.title: 阿松与阿暖 / Our Town, Her Time Episode 30
programme.desc: 台湾小镇纸艺师阿松性格固执，与家人关系紧张，人生陷入了停滞。某天，来自明朝的神秘女子阿暖突然出现成为他的徒弟，打破了他的平静生活。一段相处后，两人发现彼此有跨越三百年的命运牵连。在阿暖的影响下，阿松逐渐改变，学会面对情感与家庭，也与她产生了深刻连结。故事融合了传统文化、奇幻与成长，是一段关于改变与归属的温暖旅程。Song, a stubborn paper artisan in a small town, leads a stagnant life until Nuan, a mysterious woman from the Ming Dynasty, appears as his apprentice. As they uncover a bond spanning 300 years, Song learns to embrace love, mend family ties, and discover where he truly belongs.

programme.title: 爱的勘探法 / Exploration Method of Love Episode 17
programme.desc: 本该在野外探勘的地质学博士苏纪时，因为双胞胎妹妹苏瑾不辞而别引发的职业危机，暂时回来顶替妹妹上岗成为艺人。苏瑾先前和穆氏集团总裁穆休伦有情侣合约的协议，苏纪时在忙着提防身份被揭穿的同时，还需履行与穆休伦的假情侣合约，两人在情感中你来我往，暧昧上头。

programme.title: 爱情有烟火 / Love Has Fireworks Episode 28
programme.desc: Jin Zi confesses to Li Yifei, but he rejects her and admits his feelings for Qian Fei. He rescues Fulasida financially, recruits Lu Ze, and rushes back to meet Qian Fei.

programme.title: 正义女神 / Themis Episode 25
programme.desc: 言惠知因一宗少年案放弃晋升高院机会，转任少年法庭裁判官，也因此与丈夫离婚。她坚持“不枉不纵”，在惩罚与救赎之间守护公义，赢得法院上下敬重。立志成为最年轻高院法官的郑邵文因她的到来仕途受阻。面对连串少年罪案，两人在理念碰撞中，携手帮助迷途少年重返正轨。After a life-changing juvenile crime case, Zhi leaves a fast-track High Court career for the Juvenile Court, costing her marriage. As she and ambitious magistrate Wen tackle difficult youth cases, they balance justice, compassion and redemption.

programme.title: 百味人生 / Bittersweet Destiny Episode 65
programme.desc: 【百味人生】是一部以料理为引线，交织情感、人性与台湾文化的原创戏剧。故事围绕一位总舖师因为一宗陷害事件，使其女儿与五位徒弟从分崩离析到彼此纠葛，呈现横跨25年的恩怨情仇与家族纠结。剧中每一段故事，都对应一道人生滋味，展现爱情的甜、亲情的苦、背叛的辣、梦想的酸与欲望的咸，融合台湾人饮食文化与庶民记忆，勾勒出在生命里最熟悉的味道与情感，透过时代转变与两代间的冲突，诉说成长与和解的历程，是一部结合文化深度与情感张力的戏剧。Bittersweet Destiny is a Taiwanese original series that uses cuisine as the connecting thread to weave together themes of emotion, human nature, and Taiwanese culture. programme.title: 爱的荣耀 / Glory of Love Episode 307
programme.desc: 一桩吸金诈骗案意外改变了三个女人的命运：有如大树般坚强的女性；如花般绽放的富家千金；也有如小草般的平凡女性。借由三个女主角来传达自信、勇气及自我价值的重要性，从爱出发能克服任何困境、挖掘出无限潜能和力量！A money-driven fraud case unexpectedly alters the destinies of three women: a resilient woman resembling a sturdy tree, a wealthy daughter blossoming like a flower, and an ordinary woman akin to grass. These three heroines convey the message of self-worth, highlighting the importance of love in overcoming challenges and unlocking one’s unlimited potential.

programme.title: 重案解密 / Case X Decoded
programme.desc: 一桩悬案令警长杜凯斌与女警严灼颖心生嫌隙。多年后，两人在重查旧案中冰释前嫌，并在屡次合作办案中滋长出并肩作战的情谊，开始建立深厚的默契。他们俩身份、心态与际遇不断改变，唯有为受害者讨回公道的信念始终不变。An unsolved case drives a wedge between Inspector Du and Officer Yan. Reunited by a fresh investigation, they mend old wounds and forge a trusted partnership, while their unwavering pursuit of justice keeps them bound to the victims they serve.

The story is sparked by a frame-up incident involving a master chef, which causes his daughter and five apprentices to ...

programme.title: 爱情有烟火 / Love Has Fireworks Episode 29
programme.desc: Qian Fei grows jealous over Jin Zi's visit, then is framed as the source of leaked black material after her accounts are hacked. Fired and disillusioned, she is secretly kissed by Li Yifei.

programme.title: 阿松与阿暖 / Our Town, Her Time Episode 31
programme.desc: 台湾小镇纸艺师阿松性格固执，与家人关系紧张，人生陷入了停滞。某天，来自明朝的神秘女子阿暖突然出现成为他的徒弟，打破了他的平静生活。一段相处后，两人发现彼此有跨越三百年的命运牵连。在阿暖的影响下，阿松逐渐改变，学会面对情感与家庭，也与她产生了深刻连结。故事融合了传统文化、奇幻与成长，是一段关于改变与归属的温暖旅程。Song, a stubborn paper artisan in a small town, leads a stagnant life until Nuan, a mysterious woman from the Ming Dynasty, appears as his apprentice. As they uncover a bond spanning 300 years, Song learns to embrace love, mend family ties, and discover where he truly belongs.

programme.title: 爱的荣耀 / Glory of Love Episode 309
programme.desc: 一桩吸金诈骗案意外改变了三个女人的命运：有如大树般坚强的女性；如花般绽放的富家千金；也有如小草般的平凡女性。借由三个女主角来传达自信、勇气及自我价值的重要性，从爱出发能克服任何困境、挖掘出无限潜能和力量！A money-driven fraud case unexpectedly alters the destinies of three women: a resilient woman resembling a sturdy tree, a wealthy daughter blossoming like a flower, and an ordinary woman akin to grass. These three heroines convey the message of self-worth, highlighting the importance of love in overcoming challenges and unlocking one’s unlimited potential.

programme.title: 那些年，那些歌 / Memorable Classic Songs Episode 239
programme.desc:
全新音乐节目《那些年。那些歌》由音乐大师陈国华主持，邀请乐坛重量级歌王歌后，串连老、中、青三代音乐人，畅聊温馨感人的音乐故事，改编金典歌曲，用最动听的歌声，带领观众重温60、70年代的美好时光。
Memorable Classic Songs is a new music programs hosted by Chen Guo

programme.title: 大地餐桌 第二季 / Earthly Ambrosia S2 Episode 7
programme.desc: 延续上一季“亦庄亦谐”的风格，第二季以南北物产为出发点，延伸至各地的自然景观和人文风貌，最终呈现人与食物的故事。Showcasing local produce from the north and south, this second series extends to the natural landscapes and cultures of the regions, ultimately presenting the stories of the people and their food.

programme.title: 重案解密 / Case X Decoded Episode 2
programme.desc: 一桩悬案令警长杜凯斌与女警严灼颖心生嫌隙。多年后，两人在重查旧案中冰释前嫌，并在屡次合作办案中滋长出并肩作战的情谊，开始建立深厚的默契。他们俩身份、心态与际遇不断改变，唯有为受害者讨回公道的信念始终不变。An unsolved case drives a wedge between Inspector Du and Officer Yan. Reunited by a fresh investigation, they mend old wounds and forge a trusted partnership, while their unwavering pursuit of justice keeps them bound to the victims they serve.

programme.title: 爱的勘探法 / Exploration Method of Love Episode 19
programme.desc: 本该在野外探勘的地质学博士苏纪时，因为双胞胎妹妹苏瑾不辞而别引发的职业危机，暂时回来顶替妹妹上岗成为艺人。苏瑾先前和穆氏集团总裁穆休伦有情侣合约的协议，苏纪时在忙着提防身份被揭穿的同时，还需履行与穆休伦的假情侣合约，两人在情感中你来我往，暧昧上头。

programme.title: 超级冰冰Show / Super Bing Bing Show Episode 119
programme.desc: 【超级冰冰 Show】是台湾综艺大姐大白冰冰新开的大型台语综艺歌唱节目，联同主持的还有阳帆及台一线。两小时的节目，将邀请观众喜爱的老中青歌手，演唱经典或流行的台语歌曲，让观众听出耳油来。想听好歌，就千万别错过！

programme.title: 型男大主厨 / Stylish Man Episode 977
programme.desc: 台湾广受欢迎的常青美食料理节目，由2006年始播至今，2011年还获选金钟奖的最佳综合节目主持人奖。每一期将有不同的主题：“大明星來下廚”由兩位明星或两个明星档分組對抗，拿出自己的拿手菜對抗比拼；“五分钟出好菜”由两位厨师根据指定食材，在五分钟内烹煮出易学美味的一道菜等。这是一个富有娱乐效果的轻松美食节目，能够持续制作这么多年不是没有理由的。

programme.title: 超级夜总会 / Super Nightclub Episode 709
programme.desc: 台湾年度最新重金推出的户外歌唱综艺秀，它是耗资了千万打造的全台唯一行动舞台车，不只会全省走透透，还会邀请超级卡司，重现当年歌舞秀的热闹风光。听好歌，看好秀，就在由超级搭档——彭恰恰,许效舜所主持的〈超级夜总会〉，〈佳乐台〉抢先火速送上。

programme.title: 超級紅人榜 / Top Singers Episode 733
programme.desc: 难得一见、以台语歌曲为主的选秀节目即将登场！〈超级红人榜〉的宗旨是为了发扬台语歌曲，提供一个平台让对台语歌曲怀有热忱的各界人士发挥所长，发掘更多的演艺人才。这个节目自从开播以来屡创收视新高，通过知性风趣的于美人和选秀出生的蔡昌宪的轻松主持，您会惊讶地发现，原来台语歌曲不是年长人士的专有，原来年轻人唱起台语经典歌曲来也是很酷的！

programme.title: 追分成功 / Define Your Own Success Episode 231
programme.desc: 这是一部现代家庭伦理剧，看同住一屋簷下的单身房客，北漂追求梦想，在收获爱情、友情的同时，也面临得到与失去。他们向往完美爱情、渴望幸福婚姻、追求事业高升，不停向前“追分”，在这一路跌撞、相互陪伴的欢笑与泪水中，定义属于自己的“成功”！This drama series follows a group of single tenants under the same roof who travelled north to pursue their dreams, love and friendship. They yearn for perfect love, long for a happy marriage, and a good career advancement. Stumbling along the way with tears and laughter, they each define success by their own standards.

programme.title: 听！台湾在唱歌 2 / Listen! Taiwan Sings 2 Episode 2
programme.desc: 第二季的节目由旺福乐团主唱姚小民首次担纲主持，背着吉他走访台湾各地，与歌手来宾一同探索在地文化与音乐故事。他以音乐人的独特视角重新诠释经典歌曲，透过真诚而温暖的旅程，带领观众感受台湾的人文风情与土地魅力。新世代的金奖歌手，将走唱更多老歌及在地故事。Hosted by Wonfu’s frontman Yao Xiao Min, this season travels across Taiwan with award-winning guest artistes, reimagining classic songs and uncovering local stories through music. A heartfelt journey celebrating Taiwan's people and heritage.

programme.desc: 第二季的节目由旺福乐团主唱姚小民首次担纲主持，背着吉他走访台湾各地，与歌手来宾一同探索在地文化与音乐故事。他以音乐人的独特视角重新诠释经典歌曲，透过真诚而温暖的旅程，带领观众感受台湾的人文风情与土地魅力。新世代的金奖歌手，将走唱更多老歌及在地故事。Hosted by Wonfu’s frontman Yao Xiao Min, this season travels across Taiwan with award-winning guest artistes, reimagining classic songs and uncovering local stories through music. A heartfelt journey celebrating Taiwan's people and heritage.

programme.title: 型男大主厨 / Stylish Man Episode 978
programme.desc: 台湾广受欢迎的常青美食料理节目，由2006年始播至今，2011年还获选金钟奖的最佳综合节目主持人奖。每一期将有不同的主题：“大明星來下廚”由兩位明星或两个明星档分組對抗，拿出自己的拿手菜對抗比拼；“五分钟出好菜”由两位厨师根据指定食材，在五分钟内烹煮出易学美味的一道菜等。这是一个富有娱乐效果的轻松美食节目，能够持续制作这么多年不是没有理由的。

programme.title: 追分成功 / Define Your Own Success Episode 233
programme.desc: 这是一部现代家庭伦理剧，看同住一屋簷下的单身房客，北漂追求梦想，在收获爱情、友情的同时，也面临得到与失去。他们向往完美爱情、渴望幸福婚姻、追求事业高升，不停向前“追分”，在这一路跌撞、相互陪伴的欢笑与泪水中，定义属于自己的“成功”！This drama series follows a group of single tenants under the same roof who travelled north to pursue their dreams, love and friendship. They yearn for perfect love, long for a happy marriage, and a good career advancement. Stumbling along the way with tears and laughter, they each define success by their own standards.

programme.title: 超級紅人榜 / Top Singers Episode 734
programme.desc: 难得一见、以台语歌曲为主的选秀节目即将登场！〈超级红人榜〉的宗旨是为了发扬台语歌曲，提供一个平台让对台语歌曲怀有热忱的各界人士发挥所长，发掘更多的演艺人才。这个节目自从开播以来屡创收视新高，通过知性风趣的于美人和选秀出生的蔡昌宪的轻松主持，您会惊讶地发现，原来台语歌曲不是年长人士的专有，原来年轻人唱起台语经典歌曲来也是很酷的！

programme.title: 爱的勘探法 / Exploration Method of Love Episode 19
programme.desc: 本该在野外探勘的地质学博士苏纪时，因为双胞胎妹妹苏瑾不辞而别引发的职业危机，暂时回来顶替妹妹上岗成为艺人。苏瑾先前和穆氏集团总裁穆休伦有情侣合约的协议，苏纪时在忙着提防身份被揭穿的同时，还需履行与穆休伦的假情侣合约，两人在情感中你来我往，暧昧上头。

programme.title: 那些年，那些歌 / Memorable Classic Songs Episode 239
programme.desc:
全新音乐节目《那些年。那些歌》由音乐大师陈国华主持，邀请乐坛重量级歌王歌后，串连老、中、青三代音乐人，畅聊温馨感人的音乐故事，改编金典歌曲，用最动听的歌声，带领观众重温60、70年代的美好时光。
Memorable Classic Songs is a new music programs hosted by Chen Guo

programme.title: 重案解密 / Case X Decoded Episode 2
programme.desc: 一桩悬案令警长杜凯斌与女警严灼颖心生嫌隙。多年后，两人在重查旧案中冰释前嫌，并在屡次合作办案中滋长出并肩作战的情谊，开始建立深厚的默契。他们俩身份、心态与际遇不断改变，唯有为受害者讨回公道的信念始终不变。An unsolved case drives a wedge between Inspector Du and Officer Yan. Reunited by a fresh investigation, they mend old wounds and forge a trusted partnership, while their unwavering pursuit of justice keeps them bound to the victims they serve.

programme.title: 百味人生 / Bittersweet Destiny Episode 67
programme.desc: 【百味人生】是一部以料理为引线，交织情感、人性与台湾文化的原创戏剧。故事围绕一位总舖师因为一宗陷害事件，使其女儿与五位徒弟从分崩离析到彼此纠葛，呈现横跨25年的恩怨情仇与家族纠结。剧中每一段故事，都对应一道人生滋味，展现爱情的甜、亲情的苦、背叛的辣、梦想的酸与欲望的咸，融合台湾人饮食文化与庶民记忆，勾勒出在生命里最熟悉的味道与情感，透过时代转变与两代间的冲突，诉说成长与和解的历程，是一部结合文化深度与情感张力的戏剧。Bittersweet Destiny is a Taiwanese original series that uses cuisine as the connecting thread to weave together themes of emotion, human nature, and Taiwanese culture. programme.title: 爱的荣耀 / Glory of Love Episode 309
programme.desc: 一桩吸金诈骗案意外改变了三个女人的命运：有如大树般坚强的女性；如花般绽放的富家千金；也有如小草般的平凡女性。借由三个女主角来传达自信、勇气及自我价值的重要性，从爱出发能克服任何困境、挖掘出无限潜能和力量！A money-driven fraud case unexpectedly alters the destinies of three women: a resilient woman resembling a sturdy tree, a wealthy daughter blossoming like a flower, and an ordinary woman akin to grass. programme.title: 阿松与阿暖 / Our Town, Her Time Episode 32

programme.title: 重案解密 / Case X Decoded Episode 3
programme.desc: 一桩悬案令警长杜凯斌与女警严灼颖心生嫌隙。多年后，两人在重查旧案中冰释前嫌，并在屡次合作办案中滋长出并肩作战的情谊，开始建立深厚的默契。他们俩身份、心态与际遇不断改变，唯有为受害者讨回公道的信念始终不变。An unsolved case drives a wedge between Inspector Du and Officer Yan. Reunited by a fresh investigation, they mend old wounds and forge a trusted partnership, while their unwavering pursuit of justice keeps them bound to the victims they serve.

programme.desc: 【百味人生】是一部以料理为引线，交织情感、人性与台湾文化的原创戏剧。故事围绕一位总舖师因为一宗陷害事件，使其女儿与五位徒弟从分崩离析到彼此纠葛，呈现横跨25年的恩怨情仇与家族纠结。剧中每一段故事，都对应一道人生滋味，展现爱情的甜、亲情的苦、背叛的辣、梦想的酸与欲望的咸，融合台湾人饮食文化与庶民记忆，勾勒出在生命里最熟悉的味道与情感，透过时代转变与两代间的冲突，诉说成长与和解的历程，是一部结合文化深度与情感张力的戏剧。Bittersweet Destiny is a Taiwanese original series that uses cuisine as the connecting thread to weave together themes of emotion, human nature, and Taiwanese culture. programme.desc: 台湾小镇纸艺师阿松性格固执，与家人关系紧张，人生陷入了停滞。某天，来自明朝的神秘女子阿暖突然出现成为他的徒弟，打破了他的平静生活。一段相处后，两人发现彼此有跨越三百年的命运牵连。在阿暖的影响下，阿松逐渐改变，学会面对情感与家庭，也与她产生了深刻连结。故事融合了传统文化、奇幻与成长，是一段关于改变与归属的温暖旅程。Song, a stubborn paper artisan in a small town, leads a stagnant life until Nuan, a mysterious woman from the Ming Dynasty, appears as his apprentice. programme.title: 夜色正浓 / The Glamorous Night Episode 13
programme.desc: 该剧根据右耳的原著小说《Sales夫妇》改编，讲述了一群在洋酒行业相关工作的年轻人，行业白领们，为了业绩与生活努力奋斗拼搏，一路上被人性与现实考验，最终从底层的促销员成为行业风云人物的成长故事。Adapted from You Er’s novel "Sales Couple", the series tells the story of a group of young professionals working in the imported liquor industry as white-collar workers strive to succeed in both their careers and personal lives.

programme.title: 夜色正浓 / The Glamorous Night Episode 14
programme.desc: 该剧根据右耳的原著小说《Sales夫妇》改编，讲述了一群在洋酒行业相关工作的年轻人，行业白领们，为了业绩与生活努力奋斗拼搏，一路上被人性与现实考验，最终从底层的促销员成为行业风云人物的成长故事。Adapted from You Er’s novel "Sales Couple", the series tells the story of a group of young professionals working in the imported liquor industry as white-collar workers strive to succeed in both their careers and personal lives.

programme.title: 轧戏 / Love Between Lines Episode 5
programme.desc: 肖稚宇与胡羞因一场民国主题剧本杀结缘。漫雪纷飞、谍影交错的剧本世界里，两人碰撞出宿命火花；现实世界的意外重逢，却揭开彼此身份谜题。当剧本幻境与现实生活悄然重叠，二人穿梭于戏中戏的错位时空，最终在跨越维度的羁绊中实现双向成长，完成对爱情与自我的进阶蜕变。The story follows Xiao Zhiyu and Hu Xiu meet during a Republican-era themed role-playing game, where espionage and fate intertwine. Their unexpected real-world reunion unveils hidden identities, blurring the lines between fiction and reality. As they navigate a dislocated space-time, they grow together, transforming through love and self-discovery.

programme.title: 轧戏 / Love Between Lines Episode 6
programme.desc: 肖稚宇与胡羞因一场民国主题剧本杀结缘。漫雪纷飞、谍影交错的剧本世界里，两人碰撞出宿命火花；现实世界的意外重逢，却揭开彼此身份谜题。当剧本幻境与现实生活悄然重叠，二人穿梭于戏中戏的错位时空，最终在跨越维度的羁绊中实现双向成长，完成对爱情与自我的进阶蜕变。The story follows Xiao Zhiyu and Hu Xiu meet during a Republican-era themed role-playing game, where espionage and fate intertwine. Their unexpected real-world reunion unveils hidden identities, blurring the lines between fiction and reality. programme.title: 我不是大师 / The Prophet
programme.desc: 上官诚明全家惨遭天相派设局灭门，他化名潜伏，以牙还牙，以眼还眼，联手身陷泥淖却势要逆天改命的江飞燕，用连环骗局反噬仇敌，一路揭露骗术黑幕，最终瓦解天相派，解救受控者，惩恶扬善终彰善念。After his family is slaughtered by a powerful cult, Shangguan Chengming returns under a false identity to seek revenge. Partnering with the defiant Jiang Feiyan, he turns deception against deception, exposing dark conspiracies, toppling the sect, and delivering long-overdue justice.

programme.title: 轧戏 / Love Between Lines Episode 7
programme.desc: 肖稚宇与胡羞因一场民国主题剧本杀结缘。漫雪纷飞、谍影交错的剧本世界里，两人碰撞出宿命火花；现实世界的意外重逢，却揭开彼此身份谜题。当剧本幻境与现实生活悄然重叠，二人穿梭于戏中戏的错位时空，最终在跨越维度的羁绊中实现双向成长，完成对爱情与自我的进阶蜕变。The story follows Xiao Zhiyu and Hu Xiu meet during a Republican-era themed role-playing game, where espionage and fate intertwine. As they navigate a dislocated space-time, they grow together, transforming through love and self-discovery.

programme.title: 兄弟帮 / Big Boys Club Episode 443
programme.desc: 《兄弟帮》是由一班「好兄弟」林盛斌、梁竞徽、王梓轩、范振锋及陈国峰主持的年青人清谈节目，每集邀请歌手、艺人或不同界别人士作嘉宾，进行轻松访谈，带来时下社会热话、流行文化、潮流玩意等多元化内容。有关爱情、两性，以致同性关系，是男男女女谈之不尽的话题，节目邀来不同界别的嘉宾「谈情说爱」，探讨两性相处之道。「异度空间」专题，请来嘉宾分享不思议事件，如见鬼、UFO、奇人奇事等刺激话题。

programme.title: 老婆大人 / Just Love Episode 8
programme.desc: 第八集 光的多媒体公司开幕，通、云等前往参观。光得知敏要学习做家庭主妇，既愕然又担心，惟有提醒她大堆注意事项，令敏头痛。通欲考验敏的能力，赶英和贝返围村。放假前，敏接下怀疑父虐打自闭症儿子一案，敏大胆放弃视象审讯，成功找出真相，备受雄赞赏，劝她不要放弃做裁判官。怡拿出手镯追问雄是否曾与敏拍拖，又逼雄答应她三个要求。敏做家务手忙脚乱，被通嘲笑。光跟大陆客麦先生谈生意，麦暗示要去风月场所，光却带他去星光大道。敏到市场买菜，始知光是街坊口中疼爱老婆的好男人，心甜。敏到商场买光爱吃的芝士蛋糕时，祖与婴儿车突然不知所终，敏惊惶失措。

programme.title: 璀璨之城 & 今日知多D / This City Never Sleeps & What's On Today Episode 3
programme.desc: 尚利锋集团主席官志琛(姜大卫饰)在澳门雄霸一方，这商界巨人安排两子官孝贤(张智霖饰)、官孝君(吴卓羲饰)，出任集团联席行政总裁，平起平坐。孝贤一直视孝君为眼中钉，为瓦解孝君和其夫人王雪莹(张曦雯饰)的强大团伙，孝贤宣布与香港检控官洪海允(高海宁饰)成婚。海允与雪莹本是闺密，出身于十月初五街，但雪莹为嫁入豪门，夺去海允的情人孝君。孝贤就是要利用海允心中的仇恨，化成攻击孝君夫妇的利器。在家族各人看似充满机心的环境中，孝君却坚守正义，奋力抵抗着孝贤的步步进逼……

programme.title: 爱．回家之三代同糖 / Like Mother, Like Daughter Episode 43
programme.desc: 公关女皇唐万里(吴若希饰)独力照顾Gen Z女儿唐芯(李茵彤饰)，控制欲极强。万里的母亲唐曹嘉冰(车婉婉饰)半生相夫教子，忽然「觉醒」，由加拿大返港，决心寻回失落时光，更搬入万里家中。当年嘉冰曾因万里坚持未婚生下女儿，母女彻底闹僵，如今嘉冰却突然无预警杀入及扰乱万里的生活。万里力图维持秩序，唐芯则周旋两人之间，三代同堂火花四溅，矛盾不断。职场上，富二代老板空降「营销大神」杨帆(赵浚承饰)，与万里平起平坐正面交锋，万里事业与家庭同时迎来危机……

programme.title: 东张西望 / Scoop 2026 Episode 286
programme.desc: 《东张西望》星期一至日，紧贴追踪社会大事、趣闻逸事，并报导娱乐圈最新动态、艺人消息，以及剧集宣传和花絮。「今日突发」环节为大家追踪即日热门新闻；专题环节，深入探讨大众关心的时事、社会及民生问题，并访问相关的专家。

programme.title: 医生，你有病？ / Who Heals the Healers? Episode 8
programme.desc: 「你有病」这三个字，医生说过无数次，但甚少听人对自己讲。新闻部方东升团队再次出动，依然在寻人，寻找最不像病人的「病人」--医生。他们平时处事快、狠、准，见惯生死，但当角色互换，成为病榻上的患者或照顾者，同样会逃避与焦虑。大众眼中的神，终究是普通人，救人的医生如何自救？全新节目《医生，你有病？》，翻开医生那本难念的经，细看他们的脆弱与挣扎，还原白袍背后最真实的血肉人生。

programme.title: 天龙八部 / Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils (2021) Episode 8
programme.desc:
金庸先生为大家创造了一个波澜壮阔的武侠世界，《天龙八部》更是金庸小说系列中最受读者喜爱及追捧的巅峰之作之一，它的经典程度不言而喻，也是长盛不衰的改编题材。
故事以北宋哲宗时代为背景，通过丐帮帮主乔峰(杨佑宁饰)、大理世子段誉(白澍饰)、少林小僧虚竹(张天阳饰)三人的江湖历险与爱恨情仇，以及围绕在他们周围的一众江湖人物，展现了纷繁复杂的武林恩怨和无计可消除的贪嗔痴怨，勾勒了一幅充满人情世态的生活画卷，亦象征大千世界的芸芸众生，皆逃不出“情”这一字带来的痛苦纠缠。

programme.title: 流行都市 / Big City Shop 2026 Episode 205
programme.desc: 《流行都市》为观众介绍时令产品、健康养生、健体运动、护肤化妆、时尚服饰、婴幼儿护理、育儿知识、城中美食、饲养宠物等潮流信息，内容包罗万有！主持们亲身体验、示范或测试之外，还会邀请嘉宾带来相关专业知识。烹饪环节方面，多位手势了得的厨艺专家轮流登场，示范简单美味的健康美食、家常小菜，替大家解决煮食烦恼。

programme.title: 快乐长门人 / Happy Old Buddies Episode 142
programme.desc: 不少人或会认为长者并没有性需要，但有调查发现结果却非如此，长者只是因为不同原因引致性生活有所减少。社署临床心理学家林晧明详述世卫对性的定义，并替想跟老伴重启性生活的老友记带来建议。不过，另一半如不想恢复性行为，双方应如何沟通？

programme.title: 港生活．港享受 / Dolce Vita 2022 Episode 25
programme.desc: 香港人生活多姿多采，《港生活．港享受》既呈献高贵典雅的品味生活，也会带来贴地亲民的优质享受。节目结合多元化主题，每集探索不同范畴，并请来各行各业的精英分享成功之道。

programme.title: 东张西望 / Scoop 2026 Episode 286
programme.desc: 《东张西望》星期一至日，紧贴追踪社会大事、趣闻逸事，并报导娱乐圈最新动态、艺人消息，以及剧集宣传和花絮。「今日突发」环节为大家追踪即日热门新闻；专题环节，深入探讨大众关心的时事、社会及民生问题，并访问相关的专家。

programme.title: 香港早晨 及 世界观 / Good Morning Hong Kong and Global View
programme.desc: 报导香港、两岸及国际重要新闻。

programme.title: 老婆大人 / Just Love Episode 9
programme.desc: 第九集 敏自责大意而遗失了祖，二人到停车场寻找，一阵婴儿哭声令二人破涕为笑。昕看见基在酒吧外与一女子拉拉扯扯，接着又为被控醉酒驾驶伤人的该女子Eva作辩护律师，昕醋意大发，在庭上跟基展开骂战，雄怒责二人公私不分。昕找到Eva的男友程勇智作控方证人，基却怀疑真凶另有其人。昕要求将智转为敌意证人。昕在洗手间与Eva相遇，始知基和Eva同在孤儿院长大；Eva突然要求昕帮她认罪，昕错愕。光成功跟麦签约，最后发现是天从中帮助。光希望靠自己实力做出成绩，天安慰说欣赏他的才能才支持他开公司。光的秘书兼天的情人Debbie喝得醉醺醺，光扶着她时却被敏看到，敏一呆。

programme.title: 爱．回家之三代同糖 / Like Mother, Like Daughter Episode 43
programme.desc: 公关女皇唐万里(吴若希饰)独力照顾Gen Z女儿唐芯(李茵彤饰)，控制欲极强。万里的母亲唐曹嘉冰(车婉婉饰)半生相夫教子，忽然「觉醒」，由加拿大返港，决心寻回失落时光，更搬入万里家中。当年嘉冰曾因万里坚持未婚生下女儿，母女彻底闹僵，如今嘉冰却突然无预警杀入及扰乱万里的生活。万里力图维持秩序，唐芯则周旋两人之间，三代同堂火花四溅，矛盾不断。职场上，富二代老板空降「营销大神」杨帆(赵浚承饰)，与万里平起平坐正面交锋，万里事业与家庭同时迎来危机……

programme.title: Hands Up / Hands Up 2026 Episode 254
programme.desc:
全新儿童节目《Hands Up》鼓励小朋友勇于发问，表达自我，向目标进发！
吉祥物「酱汁家族」成员跟一众主持演出短剧，陪伴大家度过愉快时光。另会带来多首儿歌，让孩子们边唱边学习生活知识。
小朋友走进录像厂，寓学习于娱乐。透过不同主题游戏，加强逻辑思维、锻练体能；玩转STEAM实验，脑力全开！
节目特设表演小舞台，让小朋友展示才艺；齐集创意工作室，DIY小手工。小教「煮」环节，家长和子女共享亲子烹饪乐趣。

programme.title: 港女野人 / Chill. Hike. Camping Episode 9
programme.desc:
第5集 山艺摄影篇
Honey与Amber来到九龙最高的山峰飞鹅山，学习山艺摄影！在7度严寒天气下，二人背负15磅摄影器材，按照地图指示行走两公里，终于找到摄影达人Francis。他以「Lost」为摄影主题考验Honey与Amber，拍摄风景照的同时，二人亦在寻找自我，谁的作品获Francis垂青？天色渐暗，Francis带大家寻找一个摄影秘位，到底有何惊喜？Honey与Amber学到摄影技巧以外，还有什么得着？

programme.title: 兄弟帮 / Big Boys Club Episode 443
programme.desc: 《兄弟帮》是由一班「好兄弟」林盛斌、梁竞徽、王梓轩、范振锋及陈国峰主持的年青人清谈节目，每集邀请歌手、艺人或不同界别人士作嘉宾，进行轻松访谈，带来时下社会热话、流行文化、潮流玩意等多元化内容。有关爱情、两性，以致同性关系，是男男女女谈之不尽的话题，节目邀来不同界别的嘉宾「谈情说爱」，探讨两性相处之道。「异度空间」专题，请来嘉宾分享不思议事件，如见鬼、UFO、奇人奇事等刺激话题。

programme.title: 九门 & 今日知多D / Mystic Nine & What's On Today Episode 4
programme.desc: 《九门》讲述了长沙风云再起之时，张启山（陈伟霆 饰）与吴老狗（曾舜晞 饰）强强连手，携手霍仙姑（陈瑶 饰）与九门诸人共赴冒险奇局。一桩401部队的神秘失踪事件，牵出百年尘封的惊天秘辛。生死抉择、兄弟之情、门派担当与家国大义相互交织。九门众人用热血和牺牲，守护家园，共渡难关。

programme.title: 千奇百趣特工队 / Neighborhood Treasures (Sr.7) Episode 5
programme.desc: 森美、小仪这对奇趣拍文件再现屏幕，这次化身特务首领，将来自台湾、日本、香港的爆趣片段送给观众。每集艺人嘉宾分成两组，各自发挥想象力，与首领一起解答有关爆趣片段的超级难题，他们还可以向两位美女「趣特务」要求提示，不过情报孰真孰假，可要自行判断。表现最差的嘉宾要接受首领的「再培训」，到底有何惩罚等待一众来宾？

故事以北宋哲宗时代为背景，通过丐帮帮主乔峰(杨佑宁饰)、大理世子段誉(白澍饰)、少林小僧虚竹(张天阳饰)三人的江湖历险与爱恨情仇，以及围绕在他们周围的一众江湖人物，展现了纷繁复杂的武林恩怨和无计可消除的贪嗔痴怨，勾勒了一幅充满人情世态的生活画卷，亦象征大千世界的芸芸众生，皆逃不出“情”这一字带来的痛苦纠缠。

programme.title: 六点半新闻报导& 世界观 & 今日知多D / News At 18:30 & Global View & What's On Today
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六点半，报导本地、两岸及国际重要新闻。

programme.title: 东张西望 / Scoop 2026 Episode 287
programme.desc: 《东张西望》星期一至日，紧贴追踪社会大事、趣闻逸事，并报导娱乐圈最新动态、艺人消息，以及剧集宣传和花絮。「今日突发」环节为大家追踪即日热门新闻；专题环节，深入探讨大众关心的时事、社会及民生问题，并访问相关的专家。

programme.title: 爱．回家之三代同糖 / Like Mother, Like Daughter Episode 44
programme.desc: 公关女皇唐万里(吴若希饰)独力照顾Gen Z女儿唐芯(李茵彤饰)，控制欲极强。万里的母亲唐曹嘉冰(车婉婉饰)半生相夫教子，忽然「觉醒」，由加拿大返港，决心寻回失落时光，更搬入万里家中。当年嘉冰曾因万里坚持未婚生下女儿，母女彻底闹僵，如今嘉冰却突然无预警杀入及扰乱万里的生活。万里力图维持秩序，唐芯则周旋两人之间，三代同堂火花四溅，矛盾不断。职场上，富二代老板空降「营销大神」杨帆(赵浚承饰)，与万里平起平坐正面交锋，万里事业与家庭同时迎来危机……

programme.title: 璀璨之城 / This City Never Sleeps Episode 4
programme.desc: 尚利锋集团主席官志琛(姜大卫饰)在澳门雄霸一方，这商界巨人安排两子官孝贤(张智霖饰)、官孝君(吴卓羲饰)，出任集团联席行政总裁，平起平坐。孝贤一直视孝君为眼中钉，为瓦解孝君和其夫人王雪莹(张曦雯饰)的强大团伙，孝贤宣布与香港检控官洪海允(高海宁饰)成婚。海允与雪莹本是闺密，出身于十月初五街，但雪莹为嫁入豪门，夺去海允的情人孝君。孝贤就是要利用海允心中的仇恨，化成攻击孝君夫妇的利器。在家族各人看似充满机心的环境中，孝君却坚守正义，奋力抵抗着孝贤的步步进逼……

programme.title: 九门 / Mystic Nine Episode 4
programme.desc: 《九门》讲述了长沙风云再起之时，张启山（陈伟霆 饰）与吴老狗（曾舜晞 饰）强强连手，携手霍仙姑（陈瑶 饰）与九门诸人共赴冒险奇局。一桩401部队的神秘失踪事件，牵出百年尘封的惊天秘辛。生死抉择、兄弟之情、门派担当与家国大义相互交织。九门众人用热血和牺牲，守护家园，共渡难关。

programme.title: 医生，你有病？ / Who Heals the Healers? Episode 9
programme.desc: 「你有病」这三个字，医生说过无数次，但甚少听人对自己讲。新闻部方东升团队再次出动，依然在寻人，寻找最不像病人的「病人」--医生。他们平时处事快、狠、准，见惯生死，但当角色互换，成为病榻上的患者或照顾者，同样会逃避与焦虑。大众眼中的神，终究是普通人，救人的医生如何自救？全新节目《医生，你有病？》，翻开医生那本难念的经，细看他们的脆弱与挣扎，还原白袍背后最真实的血肉人生。

programme.title: 娱乐头条 / EXTRA Episode 846
programme.desc: 每晚紧贴香港娱乐圈的消息，以至世界各地的影视娱乐新闻，报导艺人最新动态、剧集和电影宣传、演唱会精华、颁奖礼盛况等，甚至远赴外地采访娱乐盛事、追踪各地影星，专访观众熟悉的歌、影、视红人，让大家瞬间掌握影视娱乐圈的动态和最新消息。

programme.title: 晚间新闻 / News Roundup
programme.desc: 报导香港、两岸、国际重要新闻以及体育消息，让你洞悉各地大事及体坛动向

programme.title: 世界观 / Global View
programme.desc: 由资深新闻工作者负责的《世界观》，带你用世界观、观世界，更阔更广看新闻、长知识。

programme.title: 兄弟帮 / Big Boys Club Episode 444
programme.desc: 《兄弟帮》是由一班「好兄弟」林盛斌、梁竞徽、王梓轩、范振锋及陈国峰主持的年青人清谈节目，每集邀请歌手、艺人或不同界别人士作嘉宾，进行轻松访谈，带来时下社会热话、流行文化、潮流玩意等多元化内容。有关爱情、两性，以致同性关系，是男男女女谈之不尽的话题，节目邀来不同界别的嘉宾「谈情说爱」，探讨两性相处之道。「异度空间」专题，请来嘉宾分享不思议事件，如见鬼、UFO、奇人奇事等刺激话题。

programme.title: 老婆大人 / Just Love Episode 9
programme.desc: 第九集 敏自责大意而遗失了祖，二人到停车场寻找，一阵婴儿哭声令二人破涕为笑。昕看见基在酒吧外与一女子拉拉扯扯，接着又为被控醉酒驾驶伤人的该女子Eva作辩护律师，昕醋意大发，在庭上跟基展开骂战，雄怒责二人公私不分。昕找到Eva的男友程勇智作控方证人，基却怀疑真凶另有其人。昕要求将智转为敌意证人。昕在洗手间与Eva相遇，始知基和Eva同在孤儿院长大；Eva突然要求昕帮她认罪，昕错愕。光成功跟麦签约，最后发现是天从中帮助。光希望靠自己实力做出成绩，天安慰说欣赏他的才能才支持他开公司。光的秘书兼天的情人Debbie喝得醉醺醺，光扶着她时却被敏看到，敏一呆。

programme.title: 流行都市 / Big City Shop 2026 Episode 206
programme.desc: 《流行都市》为观众介绍时令产品、健康养生、健体运动、护肤化妆、时尚服饰、婴幼儿护理、育儿知识、城中美食、饲养宠物等潮流信息，内容包罗万有！主持们亲身体验、示范或测试之外，还会邀请嘉宾带来相关专业知识。烹饪环节方面，多位手势了得的厨艺专家轮流登场，示范简单美味的健康美食、家常小菜，替大家解决煮食烦恼。

programme.title: 快乐长门人 / Happy Old Buddies Episode 143
programme.desc: 不少人或会认为长者并没有性需要，但有调查发现结果却非如此，长者只是因为不同原因引致性生活有所减少。社署临床心理学家林晧明详述世卫对性的定义，并替想跟老伴重启性生活的老友记带来建议。不过，另一半如不想恢复性行为，双方应如何沟通？

programme.title: 港生活．港享受 / Dolce Vita 2022 Episode 26
programme.desc: 香港人生活多姿多采，《港生活．港享受》既呈献高贵典雅的品味生活，也会带来贴地亲民的优质享受。节目结合多元化主题，每集探索不同范畴，并请来各行各业的精英分享成功之道。

programme.desc: 报导香港、两岸及国际重要新闻。

programme.title: 老婆大人 / Just Love Episode 10
programme.desc: 第十集 怡知道诗喜欢雄，逼雄拿着鲜花到瑜珈室，让敏和诗误会她跟雄拍拖。光约见雄后，始知是误会一场。天游说光一起到上海参加交易会，打开生意网络。怡开罪客人May，May要求退出会籍。贝担心怡因此被解雇，向May的男友坚求情，却被折返的May控告贝犯了招徕罪。贝向敏求助，敏灵机一动，着贝出庭自辩，成功脱罪。敏亦趁机化解怡和通的恩怨，让公干回来的光感激。敏在光的行李中发现一条钻石项链，以为是光送给她的结婚周年礼物。烛光晚餐上，敏打开生日礼物，竟是珍藏版CD，失望；接着在洗手间惊见Debbie颈上的钻石项链，伤心；敏碰见雄即抱着他痛哭，刚巧被光看见。

programme.title: Hands Up / Hands Up 2026 Episode 273
programme.desc:
全新儿童节目《Hands Up》鼓励小朋友勇于发问，表达自我，向目标进发！
吉祥物「酱汁家族」成员跟一众主持演出短剧，陪伴大家度过愉快时光。另会带来多首儿歌，让孩子们边唱边学习生活知识。
小朋友走进录像厂，寓学习于娱乐。透过不同主题游戏，加强逻辑思维、锻练体能；玩转STEAM实验，脑力全开！
节目特设表演小舞台，让小朋友展示才艺；齐集创意工作室，DIY小手工。小教「煮」环节，家长和子女共享亲子烹饪乐趣。

programme.title: 阿爷厨房 / The Ahistoric Grandpa Cooking Show (Sr.5) Episode 11
programme.desc: 铁汉李家鼎(鼎爷)武艺非凡毋庸置疑，原来厨艺亦相当「耍家」！鼎爷设立「阿爷厨房」，伙拍对美食素有要求的谭玉瑛，每集带大家搜购心水食材，并由鼎爷亲自下厨，炮制多道拿手小菜、汤水及甜品，为大家奉上怀旧粤菜好滋味！如何以「抵食价」煮出正宗古法盐焗鸡的味道？怎样掌控蒸鱼的火候和时间？秋冬时份，不少人爱吃「香喷喷」煲仔饭，更不会错过香脆的饭焦，但大家又可曾见过有两面饭焦的煲仔饭？且看鼎爷大显身手，一一教路！

programme.desc: 《兄弟帮》是由一班「好兄弟」林盛斌、梁竞徽、王梓轩、范振锋及陈国峰主持的年青人清谈节目，每集邀请歌手、艺人或不同界别人士作嘉宾，进行轻松访谈，带来时下社会热话、流行文化、潮流玩意等多元化内容。有关爱情、两性，以致同性关系，是男男女女谈之不尽的话题，节目邀来不同界别的嘉宾「谈情说爱」，探讨两性相处之道。「异度空间」专题，请来嘉宾分享不思议事件，如见鬼、UFO、奇人奇事等刺激话题。

programme.title: Hands Up / Hands Up 2026 Episode 273
programme.desc:
全新儿童节目《Hands Up》鼓励小朋友勇于发问，表达自我，向目标进发！
吉祥物「酱汁家族」成员跟一众主持演出短剧，陪伴大家度过愉快时光。另会带来多首儿歌，让孩子们边唱边学习生活知识。
小朋友走进录像厂，寓学习于娱乐。透过不同主题游戏，加强逻辑思维、锻练体能；玩转STEAM实验，脑力全开！
节目特设表演小舞台，让小朋友展示才艺；齐集创意工作室，DIY小手工。小教「煮」环节，家长和子女共享亲子烹饪乐趣。

programme.title: 流行都市 / Big City Shop 2026 Episode 207
programme.desc: 《流行都市》为观众介绍时令产品、健康养生、健体运动、护肤化妆、时尚服饰、婴幼儿护理、育儿知识、城中美食、饲养宠物等潮流信息，内容包罗万有！主持们亲身体验、示范或测试之外，还会邀请嘉宾带来相关专业知识。烹饪环节方面，多位手势了得的厨艺专家轮流登场，示范简单美味的健康美食、家常小菜，替大家解决煮食烦恼。

programme.title: 千奇百趣特工队 / Neighborhood Treasures (Sr.7) Episode 5
programme.desc: 森美、小仪这对奇趣拍文件再现屏幕，这次化身特务首领，将来自台湾、日本、香港的爆趣片段送给观众。每集艺人嘉宾分成两组，各自发挥想象力，与首领一起解答有关爆趣片段的超级难题，他们还可以向两位美女「趣特务」要求提示，不过情报孰真孰假，可要自行判断。表现最差的嘉宾要接受首领的「再培训」，到底有何惩罚等待一众来宾？

programme.title: 九门 & 今日知多D / Mystic Nine & What's On Today Episode 5
programme.desc: 《九门》讲述了长沙风云再起之时，张启山（陈伟霆 饰）与吴老狗（曾舜晞 饰）强强连手，携手霍仙姑（陈瑶 饰）与九门诸人共赴冒险奇局。一桩401部队的神秘失踪事件，牵出百年尘封的惊天秘辛。生死抉择、兄弟之情、门派担当与家国大义相互交织。九门众人用热血和牺牲，守护家园，共渡难关。

programme.title: 医生，你有病？ / Who Heals the Healers? Episode 9
programme.desc: 「你有病」这三个字，医生说过无数次，但甚少听人对自己讲。新闻部方东升团队再次出动，依然在寻人，寻找最不像病人的「病人」--医生。他们平时处事快、狠、准，见惯生死，但当角色互换，成为病榻上的患者或照顾者，同样会逃避与焦虑。大众眼中的神，终究是普通人，救人的医生如何自救？全新节目《医生，你有病？》，翻开医生那本难念的经，细看他们的脆弱与挣扎，还原白袍背后最真实的血肉人生。

programme.title: 美食新闻报道 / Gourmet Express Episode 184
programme.desc: 香港汇聚环球美食，特色佳肴、贴地料理受到识饮识食之人的密切关注！黄婉曼、蔡雪莹、倪嘉雯、黄嘉雯、廖慧仪、伍倩彤等美食主播、主持，紧贴最新饮食情报与优惠，深入了解滋味背后的故事。从不同平台网罗超人气食店的情报，主持亲自出动排队、试食，带来真实食评。不设堂食的外卖小店亦深受追捧，有何必吃之选？经营食店难免尝尽甜酸苦辣，摄制队追踪主理人忙碌的一天，从搜购食材、准备材料到开档做生意，揭开「故事味缘」。

programme.title: 最强生命线 / Vital Lifeline Episode 311
programme.desc: 都市人生活节奏紧张，压力又大，身体易出毛病，《最强生命线》为你解构健康之道。首先一连四集介绍都市痛症系列，分别是头痛，肩颈痛，背痛，关节痛。每集都会邀请医学专家讲解各种疾病的成因，还有物理治疗师，运动治疗师教做适当的运动。现在流行中西医结合，美国游泳健将菲比斯都用拔罐来纾缓疼痛，所以每集都会有中医断症，辅以针灸，拔罐和三伏天最适合做的天灸等治疗方法，另外，中医还教我们煲滋补的汤水，都可以调理身体。

programme.title: 天龙八部 / Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils (2021) Episode 10
programme.desc:
金庸先生为大家创造了一个波澜壮阔的武侠世界，《天龙八部》更是金庸小说系列中最受读者喜爱及追捧的巅峰之作之一，它的经典程度不言而喻，也是长盛不衰的改编题材。
故事以北宋哲宗时代为背景，通过丐帮帮主乔峰(杨佑宁饰)、大理世子段誉(白澍饰)、少林小僧虚竹(张天阳饰)三人的江湖历险与爱恨情仇，以及围绕在他们周围的一众江湖人物，展现了纷繁复杂的武林恩怨和无计可消除的贪嗔痴怨，勾勒了一幅充满人情世态的生活画卷，亦象征大千世界的芸芸众生，皆逃不出“情”这一字带来的痛苦纠缠。

programme.title: 璀璨之城 / This City Never Sleeps Episode 5
programme.desc: 尚利锋集团主席官志琛(姜大卫饰)在澳门雄霸一方，这商界巨人安排两子官孝贤(张智霖饰)、官孝君(吴卓羲饰)，出任集团联席行政总裁，平起平坐。孝贤一直视孝君为眼中钉，为瓦解孝君和其夫人王雪莹(张曦雯饰)的强大团伙，孝贤宣布与香港检控官洪海允(高海宁饰)成婚。海允与雪莹本是闺密，出身于十月初五街，但雪莹为嫁入豪门，夺去海允的情人孝君。孝贤就是要利用海允心中的仇恨，化成攻击孝君夫妇的利器。在家族各人看似充满机心的环境中，孝君却坚守正义，奋力抵抗着孝贤的步步进逼……

programme.title: 老婆大人 / Just Love Episode 10
programme.desc: 第十集 怡知道诗喜欢雄，逼雄拿着鲜花到瑜珈室，让敏和诗误会她跟雄拍拖。光约见雄后，始知是误会一场。天游说光一起到上海参加交易会，打开生意网络。怡开罪客人May，May要求退出会籍。贝担心怡因此被解雇，向May的男友坚求情，却被折返的May控告贝犯了招徕罪。贝向敏求助，敏灵机一动，着贝出庭自辩，成功脱罪。敏亦趁机化解怡和通的恩怨，让公干回来的光感激。敏在光的行李中发现一条钻石项链，以为是光送给她的结婚周年礼物。烛光晚餐上，敏打开生日礼物，竟是珍藏版CD，失望；接着在洗手间惊见Debbie颈上的钻石项链，伤心；敏碰见雄即抱着他痛哭，刚巧被光看见。

programme.title: 快乐长门人 / Happy Old Buddies Episode 144
programme.desc: 不少人或会认为长者并没有性需要，但有调查发现结果却非如此，长者只是因为不同原因引致性生活有所减少。社署临床心理学家林晧明详述世卫对性的定义，并替想跟老伴重启性生活的老友记带来建议。不过，另一半如不想恢复性行为，双方应如何沟通？

programme.title: Hands Up / Hands Up 2026 Episode 274
programme.desc:
全新儿童节目《Hands Up》鼓励小朋友勇于发问，表达自我，向目标进发！
吉祥物「酱汁家族」成员跟一众主持演出短剧，陪伴大家度过愉快时光。另会带来多首儿歌，让孩子们边唱边学习生活知识。
小朋友走进录像厂，寓学习于娱乐。透过不同主题游戏，加强逻辑思维、锻练体能；玩转STEAM实验，脑力全开！
节目特设表演小舞台，让小朋友展示才艺；齐集创意工作室，DIY小手工。小教「煮」环节，家长和子女共享亲子烹饪乐趣。

programme.title: 破毒强人 / Narcotics Heroes Episode 7
programme.desc: 第16集 淑贤于手机自白中，声称是因为跟罗勇有外遇，被他要挟才动杀机……子颖因担心安乐被人利用，找可儿查证，可儿迫不得已谎称章琳背后的金主是大马富翁。福田惊闻淑贤之事，认定有人教唆淑贤为他顶罪，决意要向此人报仇。福田获释后，杜飞和律师在口供房起争执，浩天趁机以减刑利诱杜飞，杜飞决定将一切和盘托出……文华重金安排枪手，要趁警方移送杜飞期间劫犯。章琳意外发现文华用毒品止痛，十分担心。

programme.title: 粤讲粤㜺鬼IV / Cantoxicating! (Sr.4) Episode 2
programme.desc:
语「㜺鬼」传神，博大精深，香港不少俗话亦源自广东省各地。
㜺鬼大使麦美恩遂将探索版图扩展至中国，并找来邓智坚、戴祖仪、许文轩加入「㜺鬼导赏团」，深入广州等内地城市，发掘相关的有趣典故及出处。专业粤语及典故专家亦会现身，追源溯古引经据典，揭示贴地粤语的魅力所在。
此外，喜欢扮鬼扮马的邓智坚还于节目化身单身宅男，透过他追求一众「女神」的过程，让大家了解多个俗语及术语的含意。

programme.title: 周六聊Teen谷 / ChatSAT Episode 41
programme.desc: 会用尽所能搜罗世界各地至潮、至新情报，上至世界盛事、医学百科、文艺与科技；下至日常生活、网络热搜，在每个星期六跟观众一一分享。论尽天南地北，畅谈人气热话，「谷友」紧贴节目，便可轻松掌握全球脉搏动向。

programme.title: 试真D唷 / Try It? Really? (Sr.2) Episode 6
programme.desc: 江美仪再度领军，携手张振朗、朱敏瀚、吴业坤、曾展望组成「试真D团队」，在首季热播及网民的热烈推崇下载誉归来。这趟全新的台湾深度探索之旅，各人将继续以轻松真实、贴地玩乐的风格，引领观众深入宝岛腹地。团队前赴高雄、台南与台北，延续节目精神，发掘在网络上评价两极的争议店铺，以及隐藏于城市角落、鲜为人知的小众新奇体验。众人坚持呈现最真实的现场反馈，旨在为观众打造一本不踩坑的实用游台指南。

programme.title: 女神配对计划2 / A Date with Goddess (Sr.2) Episode 6
programme.desc: 恋爱真人骚《女神配对计划》火热回归，第二季恋爱战场全面升级！「金牌媒人」Bob林盛斌招募全球男士，为女神何沛珈、郭佩文、陈若思、俞可程、阮嘉敏开展恋爱配对。求爱勇者接受心动揿灯、五角枱约会等挑战，各出奇谋冧女神。一对一亲密游戏引爆心跳警报，还有隐藏女神加入战团，火花进一步升温……更多求爱考验来临，勇者们力求走到最后，攻陷女神心！此外，上季五位女神与星级嘉宾们轮流成为「花生团」，直击女神约会实况。

programme.title: 千奇百趣特工队 / Neighborhood Treasures (Sr.7) Episode 5
programme.desc: 森美、小仪这对奇趣拍文件再现屏幕，这次化身特务首领，将来自台湾、日本、香港的爆趣片段送给观众。每集艺人嘉宾分成两组，各自发挥想象力，与首领一起解答有关爆趣片段的超级难题，他们还可以向两位美女「趣特务」要求提示，不过情报孰真孰假，可要自行判断。表现最差的嘉宾要接受首领的「再培训」，到底有何惩罚等待一众来宾？

programme.title: 呆佬拜寿 / Only Fools Fall in Love
programme.desc: 招福（刘青云）是招家当家，虽有财有势，聪明绝顶，但性格尖酸刻薄，终日争强好性的作风使他得不到快乐。二当家招积（黄子华）对福不满已久，再加上嫖、赌、饮、吹惹得债务累累，因此游说在街头卖艺的望弟（吴倩莲）与福假结婚以骗取聘礼。弟与其父（元华）想早日落地生根，因此答应。福在拜堂前仍往抢花炮，积转换策略，趁混乱使福从高处堕下，福变成傻佬。此时弟才知事态严重，与父一走了之，并改叮换姓重新生活。积想干脆杀福，福有幸逃脱。缘份再次安排福与弟重遇，市集中，弟见福变成乞儿，过着颠沛流离的生活，在内疚及同情心驱使下弟收留了福。二人相处中日久生情，弟难以相信自己竟被一个傻佬的真诚打动，而福从爱情中亦得到前所未有的快乐。在风和日丽的一天，积派人来到把福与弟的二人世界翻转，而且殃及了邻居，福与弟认为必需趁公正无私的太叔公（乔宏）设寿宴，回招家揭发积之恶行，取回公道。于是，一个傻佬正式向一个阴险狡猾的人宣战……

programme.title: 香港系列之细间始终你好 / Hong Kong: Never Too Small Episode 13
programme.desc: 在时代浪潮的冲刷下，描绘着城市缩影的本地小店越来越少，它们却是建构城市的重要部份，也是无可取替的香港精神。有见及此，「贴地」主持人阮兆祥引领观众一店一探秘，到访衣、食、住、行四大民生领域的老字号、新派小店，带出店铺的经营历史、守业辛酸，娓娓道来几代人背后的故事，以有形小店留下无形回忆，呈现「细间」始终美好！

programme.title: 善心满载仁爱堂 (直播) / Yan Oi Tong Charity Show 2026 (Live)
programme.desc: 人生纵然陷入逆境，但在困局之中，只要坚持下去，总能找到出路。仁爱堂就是大众的同路人，一直为社会上有需要人士提供医疗、教育、安老等支持服务。为让这份善心力量得以延续，亟需各界汇聚爱心，踊跃捐款支持。年度慈善盛会《善心满载仁爱堂》由谭俊彦、朱凯婷、麦美恩、丁子朗、刘颖旋担纲司仪，召集罗志祥、陈奂仁、尹光、冯允谦、方皓玟等实力唱将为爱献声。艺员江美仪、朱敏瀚等则透过游戏凝聚善心，同心呼吁善长们慷慨解囊。

programme.title: J Music / J Music 2026 Episode 35
programme.desc: 《J Music》致力打造高质音乐平台，一众歌手有展示音乐实力的机会之余，也可让乐迷更深入了解歌手的音乐故事。节目邀请「人气」歌手担任嘉宾，由嘉宾亲自挑选其喜欢的新旧作品，并即场演唱，分享喜爱曲目。而一些乐坛新面孔亦会亮相，透过互动交流，展现音乐潜力。此外，每集紧贴「劲歌金榜」最新形势，送上歌曲MV外，还会带来不同歌手、创作人或制作人的访问，跟观众畅谈作品，以至音乐业界的人和事。

programme.title: 周六聊Teen谷 / ChatSAT Episode 41

programme.title: 港女野人 / Chill. Hike. Camping Episode 9
programme.desc:
第5集 山艺摄影篇
Honey与Amber来到九龙最高的山峰飞鹅山，学习山艺摄影！在7度严寒天气下，二人背负15磅摄影器材，按照地图指示行走两公里，终于找到摄影达人Francis。他以「Lost」为摄影主题考验Honey与Amber，拍摄风景照的同时，二人亦在寻找自我，谁的作品获Francis垂青？天色渐暗，Francis带大家寻找一个摄影秘位，到底有何惊喜？Honey与Amber学到摄影技巧以外，还有什么得着？

programme.title: 东张西望 / Scoop 2026 Episode 289
programme.desc: 《东张西望》星期一至日，紧贴追踪社会大事、趣闻逸事，并报导娱乐圈最新动态、艺人消息，以及剧集宣传和花絮。「今日突发」环节为大家追踪即日热门新闻；专题环节，深入探讨大众关心的时事、社会及民生问题，并访问相关的专家。

programme.title: 娱乐大家 / Liza's On Line (Sr.2) Episode 10
programme.desc: 「阿姐」汪明荃、森美、苏永康、余德丞联合炮制游戏节目，邀请娱乐家族成员及嘉宾参与「狼人宫廷版」游戏，显露各人愚笨、聪颖的一面。嘉宾还会大讲夸张「真假话题」哗众取宠，事件是真是假先来一番揣测！阿姐承接上辑施展魔法，又在「Cheat Chat」餐桌上带起话题，谁可带来最强的娱乐性？阿姐人面甚广，请到不同领域的嘉宾，计有麦玲玲、薛家燕、何超莲、姜皓文、方力申、钱嘉乐等，一同争取最佳表现及丰富奖品！

programme.title: 港生活．港享受 / Dolce Vita 2022 Episode 26
programme.desc: 香港人生活多姿多采，《港生活．港享受》既呈献高贵典雅的品味生活，也会带来贴地亲民的优质享受。节目结合多元化主题，每集探索不同范畴，并请来各行各业的精英分享成功之道。

programme.title: 香港系列之细间始终你好 / Hong Kong: Never Too Small Episode 13
programme.desc: 在时代浪潮的冲刷下，描绘着城市缩影的本地小店越来越少，它们却是建构城市的重要部份，也是无可取替的香港精神。有见及此，「贴地」主持人阮兆祥引领观众一店一探秘，到访衣、食、住、行四大民生领域的老字号、新派小店，带出店铺的经营历史、守业辛酸，娓娓道来几代人背后的故事，以有形小店留下无形回忆，呈现「细间」始终美好！

programme.title: 破毒强人 / Narcotics Heroes Episode 9
programme.desc: 第16集 淑贤于手机自白中，声称是因为跟罗勇有外遇，被他要挟才动杀机……子颖因担心安乐被人利用，找可儿查证，可儿迫不得已谎称章琳背后的金主是大马富翁。福田惊闻淑贤之事，认定有人教唆淑贤为他顶罪，决意要向此人报仇。福田获释后，杜飞和律师在口供房起争执，浩天趁机以减刑利诱杜飞，杜飞决定将一切和盘托出……文华重金安排枪手，要趁警方移送杜飞期间劫犯。章琳意外发现文华用毒品止痛，十分担心。

programme.title: 新闻掏宝 / News Treasury 2026 Episode 38
programme.desc: 常言道：「今日新闻，明日历史」。每天那么多新闻，大家可能来不及消化，更遑论回望历史。历史就是一个大宝库，少看历史和小看历史，很容易「走宝」。新节目《新闻掏宝》带大家在宝库「掏」新闻宝藏，除了昔日特辑、直播和系列报导，还有从未曝光的珍贵片段，观众有机会重温李小龙出殡、宝生银行劫案、四人帮审讯、英女王访港、的士罢驶、中英签订联合声明、戴卓尔夫人专访、越南难民、尤德逝世、彭定康抵港、启德机场关闭、邓小平逝世、九七回归大典、华航香港空难和沙士记者会。

programme.title: 流行经典50年 / Cantopop At 50 Episode 136
programme.desc: 中外乐坛历年来诞生无数金曲，不论甚么年代的作品，皆各有知音人。《流行经典50年》邀请原唱人或实力歌手，再次演绎这些流行一时，兼且跨越多代的经典，为乐迷带来高质素的音乐享受。除了具份量的乐坛前辈之外，不少久未露面的歌手亦应邀在节目现身，献给观众多重惊喜。

programme.desc: 人生纵然陷入逆境，但在困局之中，只要坚持下去，总能找到出路。仁爱堂就是大众的同路人，一直为社会上有需要人士提供医疗、教育、安老等支持服务。为让这份善心力量得以延续，亟需各界汇聚爱心，踊跃捐款支持。年度慈善盛会《善心满载仁爱堂》由谭俊彦、朱凯婷、麦美恩、丁子朗、刘颖旋担纲司仪，召集罗志祥、陈奂仁、尹光、冯允谦、方皓玟等实力唱将为爱献声。艺员江美仪、朱敏瀚等则透过游戏凝聚善心，同心呼吁善长们慷慨解囊。

programme.title: 试真D唷 / Try It? Really? (Sr.2) Episode 7
programme.desc: 江美仪再度领军，携手张振朗、朱敏瀚、吴业坤、曾展望组成「试真D团队」，在首季热播及网民的热烈推崇下载誉归来。这趟全新的台湾深度探索之旅，各人将继续以轻松真实、贴地玩乐的风格，引领观众深入宝岛腹地。团队前赴高雄、台南与台北，延续节目精神，发掘在网络上评价两极的争议店铺，以及隐藏于城市角落、鲜为人知的小众新奇体验。众人坚持呈现最真实的现场反馈，旨在为观众打造一本不踩坑的实用游台指南。

programme.title: 女神配对计划2 / A Date with Goddess (Sr.2) Episode 7
programme.desc: 恋爱真人骚《女神配对计划》火热回归，第二季恋爱战场全面升级！「金牌媒人」Bob林盛斌招募全球男士，为女神何沛珈、郭佩文、陈若思、俞可程、阮嘉敏开展恋爱配对。求爱勇者接受心动揿灯、五角枱约会等挑战，各出奇谋冧女神。一对一亲密游戏引爆心跳警报，还有隐藏女神加入战团，火花进一步升温……更多求爱考验来临，勇者们力求走到最后，攻陷女神心！此外，上季五位女神与星级嘉宾们轮流成为「花生团」，直击女神约会实况。

programme.title: 一周星星 / Star Weekly Episode 45
programme.desc: 访谈节目《一周星星》，每集邀请星级艺人、界别名人，与区永权、许文轩、王镇泉等娱乐主播，分享新近工作企划，谈论电影、电视、演唱会相关的特别话题，尤其是网民与圈中朋友关心热议的人和事！周边讯息如此多，节目特设「Fact Check」核实环节，由嘉宾亲自回应各式各样的传闻，让当事人说清楚个中真相！

programme.desc: 第十一集 敏追问光是否有事隐瞒，光支吾以对令她伤心，欲与光分居。昕向基打听光与Debbie的关系，基知道敏误会光有婚外情，着光与通将计就计。敏为讨好通，答应返围村住，光大喜。诗到围村碰见云怒赶爱犬「大饭」离家，与他发生龃龉。其后饭竟偷偷上了诗的车，诗决定收养牠。云控告她盗窃，雄测试饭自愿跟谁，结果饭走向诗，诗的控罪不成立，云对饭依依不舍。祖突然叫敏一声妈，令敏惊喜万分。敏向雄辞职，要做全职家庭主妇。光感激敏为家庭牺牲理想，敏着他也要牺牲，光一头雾水。敏和光返公司，着光与Debbie分手，始知光与通的诡计，更发现是天支持光创业，怒不可遏。

programme.desc: 「你有病」这三个字，医生说过无数次，但甚少听人对自己讲。新闻部方东升团队再次出动，依然在寻人，寻找最不像病人的「病人」--医生。他们平时处事快、狠、准，见惯生死，但当角色互换，成为病榻上的患者或照顾者，同样会逃避与焦虑。大众眼中的神，终究是普通人，救人的医生如何自救？全新节目《医生，你有病？》，翻开医生那本难念的经，细看他们的脆弱与挣扎，还原白袍背后最真实的血肉人生。

programme.title: 新闻掏宝 / News Treasury 2026 Episode 38
programme.desc: 常言道：「今日新闻，明日历史」。每天那么多新闻，大家可能来不及消化，更遑论回望历史。历史就是一个大宝库，少看历史和小看历史，很容易「走宝」。新节目《新闻掏宝》带大家在宝库「掏」新闻宝藏，除了昔日特辑、直播和系列报导，还有从未曝光的珍贵片段，观众有机会重温李小龙出殡、宝生银行劫案、四人帮审讯、英女王访港、的士罢驶、中英签订联合声明、戴卓尔夫人专访、越南难民、尤德逝世、彭定康抵港、启德机场关闭、邓小平逝世、九七回归大典、华航香港空难和沙士记者会。

programme.desc: 尚利锋集团主席官志琛(姜大卫饰)在澳门雄霸一方，这商界巨人安排两子官孝贤(张智霖饰)、官孝君(吴卓羲饰)，出任集团联席行政总裁，平起平坐。孝贤一直视孝君为眼中钉，为瓦解孝君和其夫人王雪莹(张曦雯饰)的强大团伙，孝贤宣布与香港检控官洪海允(高海宁饰)成婚。海允与雪莹本是闺密，出身于十月初五街，但雪莹为嫁入豪门，夺去海允的情人孝君。孝贤就是要利用海允心中的仇恨，化成攻击孝君夫妇的利器。在家族各人看似充满机心的环境中，孝君却坚守正义，奋力抵抗着孝贤的步步进逼……

programme.title: 见步行步 台湾篇 / I Go To Taiwan On Foot Episode 7
programme.desc:
第8集 农乡寻找「在地的滋味」
赚钱困难洗钱快，焯日、景行被带到理发厅光顾一下，已花掉四分三的旅费。重点是两人都没现金在身，究竟是装傻还是互相推卸？
来到火车站，两人用余钱选往门票范围内最远的车站，打算下车后再「见步行步」！
他们在名为「石榴」的车站下车，只见遍地农田，连节目组都搞不清当地有何特产，所以要二人随处逛逛发掘在地滋味。幸有农民热心帮忙，为他们提供拔芋头的临时工。
辛勤过后有消暑冰作回报，还有采摘咖啡豆的任务在等待着二人？

programme.title: 天龙八部 / Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils (2021) Episode 16
programme.desc:
金庸先生为大家创造了一个波澜壮阔的武侠世界，《天龙八部》更是金庸小说系列中最受读者喜爱及追捧的巅峰之作之一，它的经典程度不言而喻，也是长盛不衰的改编题材。
故事以北宋哲宗时代为背景，通过丐帮帮主乔峰(杨佑宁饰)、大理世子段誉(白澍饰)、少林小僧虚竹(张天阳饰)三人的江湖历险与爱恨情仇，以及围绕在他们周围的一众江湖人物，展现了纷繁复杂的武林恩怨和无计可消除的贪嗔痴怨，勾勒了一幅充满人情世态的生活画卷，亦象征大千世界的芸芸众生，皆逃不出“情”这一字带来的痛苦纠缠。
